articleTitle: Optimization of Tube Slot Patch Antenna for TeraHertz Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In recent decades, there has been a lot of fascination with THz innovation. THz antennas are vital components in wireless communication for transferring and receiving electromagnetic fields in the developing THz system because of their appealing qualities of compact size, wider spectrum, and greater data rate. This paper suggests the unique slotted rectangular patch antenna based on a metamaterial structure and analyses the antenna performances. It has been noted that the traditional antenna's efficiency is really subpar and that the metamaterial structure influences the EM radiation and improves the performance. As a result, the rectangular patch is modified with the metamaterial structure by incorporating a tube slot into the antenna. Furthermore, the features of the patch antenna are studied by optimizing the slot number and thickness. The optimized tube slot patch antenna produces an excellent result of −58.17 dB return loss with a good gain of 8.6 dBi at the operating frequency of 2.37 THz. The proposed typical metamaterial antenna is suitable for wireless devices with greater data rates, THz imaging and medical domains.

articleTitle: Enhancing Traffic Surveillance and Urban Mobility with Vision-Based Vehicle Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Covering a spectrum of approaches from traditional methods to cutting-edge deep learning models, this comprehensive examination delves into the latest advancements in vehicle detection, recognition, and tracking through vision-based methodologies, offering a thorough analysis of their strengths, limitations, and realworld applications. Beginning with the evolution of vehicle detection methods, it explores traditional techniques like edge-based methods and motion segmentation approaches such as frame differencing, background subtraction, and optical flow, showcasing their efficacy in identifying moving vehicles and their historical significance in early traffic surveillance systems. Emphasizing the transformative impact of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), particularly in challenging scenarios marked by occlusion and varying lighting conditions, the paper details how CNNs have revolutionized vehicle detection accuracy. Beyond detection, it examines vehicle recognition and classification techniques such as colour recognition, license plate recognition, logo recognition, and vehicle type classification, highlighting their practical applications in traffic analysis, security, and urban planning. The exploration extends to vehicle tracking strategies, encompassing model -based, shape -based, and feature based approaches, with a comparative analysis of tracking algorithms based on factors like accuracy, computational efficiency, and adaptability. This comprehensive research offers valuable insights for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers aiming to advance traffic surveillance systems and shape the future of urban mobility through vision-based vehicle analysis.

articleTitle: Efficient Power Optimization in CNN Acceleration through Innovative Hardware Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the expanding realm of image recognition tasks, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have risen as indispensable tools, penetrating domains from autonomous systems to medical diagnostics. However, as their range of applications expands, the demand for effective hardware implementations grows. The Tiny YOLO architecture is the primary subject of this paper's analysis since it introduces a revolutionary power-efficient design paradigm specifically suited for CNNs. A Wallace Tree Multiplier and a Brent Kung Adder, which are deliberately positioned to reduce resource utilization and power consumption while maintaining computing prowess, are meticulously woven into our method. Empirical analyses support the effectiveness of our strategy, highlighting significant energy savings together with computational effectiveness, finally resulting in a comprehensive and workable method for power-efficient CNN acceleration. Our method has the potential to revolutionize the field of energy-efficient deep learning by combining the inherent capabilities of the Tiny YOLO architecture with smartly designed hardware components.

articleTitle: HealthApex: Complete Healthcare Assistance With Consent Based Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: HealthApex is an advanced web application in the field of health industry. It is a perfect amalgamation of Artificial Intelligence and Health System. This application consists of various modules for prediction of chronic diseases atan early stage. It uses a number of Machine Learning algorithms such as Decision Tree Classifier, Random Forest etc. It also comes with other features such as Real-Time COVID Dashboard and Old Age Care Unit. It also helps in locating nearby medical emergency services. A smart Sentiment and Communication Bot will interact with the users in real time regarding their health problem and will suggest the required assistance. Hence, this web application is made keeping in mind the wellbeing of general public.

articleTitle: Smart Indicator and Parking Identification in Two Wheelers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed and tested two related systems such as the Automatic Indicator System (AIS) and the No Parking Indication System (NPIS). Both systems play crucial roles in enhancing traffic management and ensuring road safety. The Automatic Indicator System (AIS) is a technology-driven solution designed to improve the efficiency and reliability of indicators on vehicles. Traditionally, drivers manually operate indicators to signal their intentions while changing lanes or making turns. However, human error or negligence can result in inaccurate or delayed signals, leading to potential accidents and confusion among other road users. The AIS aims to address these challenges by automating the indicator operation process and NPIS utilizes a network of sensors and intelligent signage systems strategically placed in parking areas, streets and relevant locations. These sensors detect the presence of vehicles in prohibited or limited parking zones and trigger the corresponding indicators. These indicators can be in the form of LED displays, flashing lights or electronic message boards, clearly conveying the no parking rules and informing drivers about alternative parking options. Together, the AIS and NPIS systems contribute to efficient traffic management, improved road safety and enhanced convenience for drivers. By automating the indicator operation process, AIS ensures timely and accurate signaling, reducing the risk of accidents and improving overall traffic flow. The NPIS helps prevent illegal parking and guides drivers to suitable parking alternatives, minimizing traffic disruptions and creating a safer environment for all road users.

articleTitle: CNN Framework for Automatic Segmentation of Breast Section from Thermal Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Breast cancer is considered a severe illness in the female society, and if left untreated, it can be fatal. It is always desirable to detect the BC early utilizing a selected imaging strategy. Thermogram supported breast abnormality detection is one of the recent technique and this gives the necessary information in the form of the distributed thermal pattern. This research aims to implement the Convolutional-Neural-Network (CNN) based segmentation technique to extract breast region from the chosen thermogram. This scheme's multiple stages include: (i) data collecting and processing, (ii) implementation of CNN segmentation to extract the breast, (iii) comparing it to the binary-mask and computing performance metrics, and (iv) performance evaluation and verification of the chosen CNN techniques. Pre-trained CNN segmentations are used in this work to extract the necessary section from the thermogram, and the experimental results show that the VGG-UNet methodology helps to extract the essential region with an enhanced accuracy of 97.260.64% when compared to other CNN approaches.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Improved Phishing Detection using Adversarial Auto Encoder
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Phishing scams are frequently used by malicious actors to get login credentials from unsuspecting users. One method for detecting phishing is machine learning. Despite the fact that the accuracy of machine learning algorithms is mostly determined by the training data, there isn't much easily accessible attack data. We present a method for enhancing the datasets used by machine learning algorithms. We create samples that resemble phishing websites using an Adversarial Auto Encoder (AAE) and offer metrics to judge the effectiveness of the samples. We compare these samples to models created from actual data. Some of the created samples could be impossible for the current model to recognize. After that, training is done with the remaining samples. Improved levels of accuracy and reliability are provided by the upgraded machine learning models. In other words, phishing detection is improved during model construction by merging data from real phishing sites with AAE fake data.

articleTitle: Solar-Powered Mobile Phone Charger Tapping into Sustainable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In a world reliant on smartphones, iPods, and smart watches, the persistent need for battery charging, particularly in areas devoid of electrical infrastructure, poses a formidable challenge. Solar power, a renewable energy source, emerges as a promising solution for mobile device charging, tapping into the sun's limitless energy potential. Despite its promise, solar energy has yet to become a dominant energy source for daily use. As technology continues to shrink the components within mobile devices, users have resorted to carrying spare batteries to address limited battery life. This study explores the integration of solar energy into the realm of mobile phone charging offering insights into the essential components required and the working principle behind solar-powered mobile chargers. This research work serves as a comprehensive guide to understanding the potential and mechanics of solar-powered mobile phone chargers, providing an eco-friendly and sustainable solution to the enduring dilemma of mobile device charging, particularly in regions lacking access to conventional power sources.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Machine Learning Algorithms for Crop Yield Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The agriculture sector of India is the backbone of Indian economy and has contributed 18.06% in the country total GDP in the year 2021-22. With the rise in population of India, the demand for agriculture production from the same land has also increased. As the crop demand increases, it will be supportive to the formers if they can predict the crop yield in future. But the task of crop yield prediction is challenging due to factors such as unpredictable rainfall trends, multiple climatic conditions and seasonal production trends. Recently Machine learning techniques are widely used for weather forecasting, crop recommendation, weed management, fertilizer recommendation and so on in Agriculture sector. All the data taken as input are real time data, however the performance of the machine learning models vary with the amount of ground truth data. Machine learning algorithms namely Multiple Linear Regressor, Random Forest algorithm, Decision Tree Gradient Boosting, and Extreme Gradient Boost, are evaluated in the proposed work to predict specific crop yield. The performance metrics used to evaluate the these Machine Learning algorithms are Accuracy, R2, and Adjusted R2. The proposed work achieves an accuracy of 93.95% accuracy, 92.06% of R2 score,89.95% of adjusted R2 score for gradient boosting, an accuracy of 93.95%, R2 score of 93.45% and adjusted R2 score of 91.25 for extreme gradient boosting algorithms.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Irregular Contraction and Relaxation of Cardiac Muscle using Alexnet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Congestive heart failure and arrhythmias are the two cardiovascular conditions that afflict the most people worldwide. A significant majority of modern techniques for automated classification of cardio-vascular diseases rely on traits that are manually generated. The major objective of this research is to create a deep learning-based method that can perform feature identification without the aid of humans. Alex Net convolutional neural network (CNN) using 5,655 singlelead ECGs has been used in this research. In the beginning, the researchers employed the Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT) to transform all of the 30s signals into spectrograms, which were then converted into RGB images. As a result, with a few modest modifications to the metrics, it has been sent to Alex Net and trained. In this research, Alex net CNN has been used to find out the two diseases which the result is superior when compared to all other conventional techniques, with a remarkable accuracy of 97.9%, an F1 score of 98.82 percent, and higher overall sensitivity (97.8%) and specificity (91.6%).

articleTitle: Mobile Based Deep Learning Application for Weed and Medicinal Plant Detection Using YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: YOLOv5-based approach for detecting plant weeds, and medicinal plants. The method utilizes a diverse Kaggle dataset and employs Image Label for precise annotations. The YOLOv5 model is trained to identify weeds, and medicinal plants. Performance evaluation demonstrates high accuracy, with metrics such as precision, recall, and F1 score. The approach shows potential for real-time applications in agriculture and botanical research, weed detection, and identification of valuable medicinal plants. The developed solution can greatly benefit farmers, researchers, and botanists in their efforts to tackle plant-related challenges.

articleTitle: Detection of Disease on Tomato Leaf Using SVM and K-Means Clustering Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Agriculture ensures that everyone has access to food even in situations where the population is growing rapidly. Avoiding food shortages is dependent on taking preventative measures against plant diseases. Unfortunately, anticipating diseases in immature crops is a common occurrence. The report aims to educate farmers on new methods of protecting plants from leaf diseases using cutting-edge technologies.Since tomatoes are so widely consumed, it was necessary to find a way to accurately detect leaf diseases in tomato plants using solely machine learning and image processing techniques. In this study, we collect samples of sick tomato leaves to analyse. There is a flaw in these tomato leaves that helps growers detect diseases early on. To sort information, K-means clustering is used. Use of many descriptors allows for maximum information extraction from the leaf samples. The collected features are then sorted into groups using machine learning methods like Support Vector Machine (SVM). Experimental analyses are performed using the benchmark dataset.

articleTitle: Audio Deepfake Detection Using Data Augmented Graph Frequency Cepstral Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Automatic speaker verification (ASV) systems serve an important role in identifying speakers in a variety of domains by enabling authentication, convenience, fraud detection, personalization, and forensic applications. The demand for ASV systems originates from how simple and effective speech biometrics may be. The growing popularity of such applications raises concerns about the growing possibility of speech attack. The purpose of this research is to identify audio spoofing attacks in an ASV system. The suggested model has a front -end and a back -end. The front -end has two features: Gammatone Cepstral Coefficients (GTCC) and Graph Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (GFCC) based on Spectrograms. Four machine learning models are utilised in the backend: Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and K-nearest Neighbour (KNN), as well as one deep learning model named Long Short -Term Memory (LSTM) and a transfer learning based pertained ResNet 50 model. The Logical Access (LA) partition of ASVspoof 2021 is used for training, whereas the Deepfakes (DF) portion of ASVspoof 2021 is used for testing. To address the issue of dataset imbalance, methods such as SpecAugment and Speed perturbation are used to extracted features, particularly GTCC features. For deep fake detection, the suggested model, which combines GFCC with pretrained ResNet50, obtains an outstanding Equal Error Rate (EER) of 1.78% and a tandem-Detection Cost Function (t-DCF) of 0.0458min.

articleTitle: Detection of TB from Chest X-ray: A Study with EfficientNet
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The lung is one of the prime organs, and any disease in the lung causes mild to severe breathing problems; untreated lung disease will lead to several complications. Tuberculosis (TB) is a lung ailment that needs premature recognition and handling. The primary objective is to employ the deep-learning (DL) based TB detection using chest <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$X$</tex>-rays. Various stages of the proposed scheme consist of (i) data collection and resizing, (ii) DL-supported feature extraction, (iii) binary classification and five-fold cross-validation, and (iv) comparison with earlier results and confirming the merit of the scheme. This research implements EfficientNet (EN) variants to classify the chosen <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{X}$</tex>-rays into healthy/TB classes using the SoftMax classifier. The proposed scheme with EN_B2 (ENB2) has been successful in providing an accuracy of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$96{\% }$</tex> as far as detection accuracy is considered when compared to other methods. The superiority of the suggested strategy is also confirmed by an analysis using the most recent technology, which confirms the worth of the proposed system on the chosen <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{X}$</tex>-ray imagery.

articleTitle: Lightweight Deep-Learning Based Music Genre Classification: A Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Deep-learning (DL) applications that are used real-time across various industries have gained a lot of traction and have become increasingly popular, especially when it comes to data-driven recommendation systems. This work aims to develop a DL scheme to support the music-recommendation system (MS) based on the music data. The various phases of this scheme includes; (i) data collection and signal-image conversion to get the necessary RGB scale images from the data, (ii) pre-trained DL based feature extraction, and (iii) deep-features based detection to recommend the appropriate music. This research considered the classic- (CL) and pop-music (PO) for the examination and the achieved results are evaluated to substantiate the performance of this arrangement. In this work, the signal-image conversion procedure is implemented to convert 1D signal to 2D image and then it is examined using proposed technique. The experimental outcome is separately presented for (i) spectrogram and (ii) synchro-extracting-transform and obtained results are presented. The experimental investigation is presented with MobileNet variants and this study authorizes that the implemented scheme achieved a better detection MobileNetV2 (>99%) compared to other schemes in this study.

articleTitle: A Robust Blind Watermarking Technique for Improved Medical Image Security
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Watermarking serves as a protective approach for medical data which ensures protection against illegal access. This new method uses wavelet decomposition to analyze and visualize images with varying resolutions, mirroring the human visual system. Watermarks are strategically added to the high-frequency subbands of wavelet-transformed images remaining imperceptible to the human eye, thereby enhancing the security of the watermarking scheme. However, the limitations of existing wavelets in detecting singularities across different frequency bands necessitated the development of novel filter designs capable of unveiling singularities in all orientations. Here it introduces innovative nontensor product wavelet filter banks, employing special symmetric matrices to uncover singularities comprehensively. Experimental investigations demonstrate the superiority of these new wavelet filter banks in singularity detection compared to conventional wavelets. Building upon these advancements, a modified significant difference watermarking algorithm is proposed, further enhancing the security of medical image data

articleTitle: Smart Parking and Parking Guidance Using ECNN Algorithm in Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Smart Parking and Parking Guidance finding parking methods are in demand in modern megacities. This will reduce traffic, air pollution, driver strain and wasted parking time. This paper presents the design and implementation of an improved version of a CNN based on a parking dataset for finding free parking spaces in parking images. The purpose of this paper is to produce a reliable version with fast generalization that can get information about parking, but it is intended for use with technical cameras that display the number of new parking spaces. This paper provides 94% application accuracy when advertising multiple parking lots. This version also achieved an overall accuracy of 94% while receiving single parking and testicle parking information with a digital camera at an alternative parking lot. Previous reasoning suggests that these pictures should have strong generalizability. These generalizations allow the expert version to be deployed in real parking management structures. It can also serve as the basis for a study to gather new information about parking volumes or add more layers to refine and improve versions.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Diabetic Foot-Ulcer from Tsallis and Aquila-Optmizer Enhanced Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The occurrence of the diabetes is gradually rising globally and it cause mild to severe illness in humankind. Diabetic Foot-Ulcer (DU) is one of the complications due to diabetes and it causes various problems if untreated. Appropriate screening procedure is necessary to identify the severity of the DU before the treatment is planned and implemented. This research aims to propose a methodology to extract the DU fragment from the preferred RGB-scale image for the examination. The various stages of this scheme involves in; (i) Image collection and resizing, (ii) pre-processing the images using Tsallis-entropy and Aquila-optimizer (TE+AO) assisted thresholding, (iii) extracting DU section using chosen segmentation procedure and (iv) Comparing the extracted region with ground-truth (GT) and computing the quality metrics. This study considered 500 test images for the study and the experimental investigation is implemented using MATLAB®. The merit of this scheme is verified using levelset, Chan-Vese and active-contour procedures and the achieved results are compared to verify the merit of the implemented scheme. The outcome of this study confirms that the proposed techniques presents a Dice-index of >95%, which confirms the significance of the developed tool.

articleTitle: Aerial Vehicle Landing on a Sloped Surface with Variable Skid Height Using Canny Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper proposes a modified skid for the aerial vehicle to land on the sloped surface such as mountainous region or hill station without any difficulty for the pilot of the aerial vehicle or unmanned aerial vehicle. By finding the angle of slope of the landscape surface will be used to alter the height of the skid and safely land the aerial vehicle in the sloped area. A camera is fixed at the front end of the aerial vehicle to capture perspective view of the landscape at the 45-degree angle. The shaft of the gear motor is connected to the top of the skid. Haar cascade algorithm and Canny edge detection algorithm are incorporated in this work. Haar cascade algorithm and canny edge detection is used to detect objects in the landscape and to find the boundaries of the landscape in an image. A modified skid uses the gear motor to perform the linear motion to alter the height of the skid. The Modified skid is to enable the aerial vehicle to land on the sloped surface safely without any difficulty.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Diabetes Classification and Prediction for Healthcare Applications Using Advanced Genetic Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The giant quantity of records contained in clinical databases makes facts classification a hard information mining challenge. When used on clinical data, hybrid classification improves the accuracy of disorder classification and prediction. To reap this goal, this find out about proposes three techniques to precisely classify affected person clinical information by means of setting up ultimate affiliation rules. The three techniques are deep neural gaining knowledge of and built-in round Advanced Genetic Optimization (AGO)-based deep neural connectivity classification (ABGO-DNAC), and amplified classification. Gradient power derived from integration primarily based on optimized affiliation regulations Using the three techniques proposed above can lead to higher diabetes analysis results, greater classification accuracy and much less time AGO technique is to enhance the classification accuracy of diabetes diagnosis. An expanded evolutionary algorithm is used to consider the matching feature of every characteristic to produce the first-rate viable set of matching rules. The proposed AGO technique makes use of an elevated gradient by-product classifier to operate classification primarily based on predefined affiliation policies AGO. Attributes are equipped in accordance to IDGBC selection trees.

articleTitle: Implementation of Multi-Functional Pump Therapy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Pump therapy stands out as the leading method to emulate physiological processes effectively. Moreover, it has the potential to address challenges related to drug distribution and allergies. The OmniPod Multi-Functional Pumping and Cartridge System Technology, which is the subject of this proposal, aims to introduce a ground-breaking development in the field of medical technology. Our goal is to create a cuttingedge tool that unifies several functions onto a single, approachable platform, revolutionizing medical treatment. The goal of this ground-breaking solution is to improve patient care while also vastly bettering the state of healthcare as a whole. In our strategy, mobility, use, and convenience are given priority. By easing the strain on patients and caregivers, we want to increase patients' adherence to recommended therapies and, as a result, improve health outcomes. By integrating a cutting-edge cartridge system, we simplify drug management while lowering waste and promoting environmentally friendly medical procedures.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Cost Blood grouping Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: One of the most common illnesses worldwide is diabetes. A blood sample from a finger prick is currently required for invasive methods. A tedious process must be repeated and increases the risk of infection. In this paper, a low-cost non-invasive detector for blood grouping assessment without blood sampling is proposed and constructed. The foundation of this non-invasive gadget is the NIR spectroscopy technology, which uses specialized short wavelengths to identify blood clumping molecules. The proposed technique is implemented using CNN based machine learning techniques like feature extraction and model training etc. By using this proposed non-invasive device, the patient can have a proper dose of insulin or other kind of medication and can control the Blood grouping during physical activities. The simulation is developed and shown for the identification of kinds blood group using machine learning model.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Singular Spectrum Analysis for Forecasting Air Contamination
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This study aims to assess the current state and progress of academic research on using machine learning techniques to simulate the problems associated with air pollution. Air is the composition of Nitrogen, oxygen and various other gases. The excessive presence of few gases namely NO2, CO, SO2 etc., causes air pollution which has a significant influence on the atmosphere . This leads to global warming , acid rain causing serious health effects. An efficient Air Pollution Monitoring System is essential to avoid imbalance in nature. Therefore, there is a need to put forward a Real -Time Air Pollution Monitoring and Prediction of the Air Quality Index (AQI) of Carbon Monoxide (CO), Sulphur Dioxide (SO2) and Nitrogen Dioxide (NO2) by introducing a Forecast BySsa , a machine learning forecasting uncertainties may arise in the results of air pollution models due to gaps in the data used for their development. Singular Spectrum Analysis (SSA) is a non-parametric method that offers several advantages over the other machine learning algorithms , which eliminates the need for assumptions about the underlying data distribution, making it more flexible than other parametric methods such as linear regression , which can be constrained by data assumptions . It can be used to filter out noise and other unwanted components from time series data, allowing researchers to focus on the underlying signals of interest . Overall , SSA is a powerful data analysis technique that offers several advantages , particularly for analyzing time series data. algorithm for environmental protection which is cost effective, reliable, scalable and accurate. An IOT device is utilized as the prototype to collect data from gas sensors such as MQ2, MQ9, MQ 135. A web application that displays the air pollution statistics for the next 10 days is created using . NET Framework , for further analysis and prediction. This paper emphasizes on the usage of Singular Spectrum Analysis for training and evaluation of the machine learning model . In addition, SSA has an advantage of working with long range non-linear datasets.

articleTitle: Enhancing Biomedical Literature Analysis to Predict Drug Interactions Using Multi Criteria Decision Making and LSTM-CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The extraction of information from unstructured text has become a crucial task in the biomedical literature field. Specifically, the analysis of various relationships such as Drug Food, Drug Disease, Drug non-prescription and Drug Drug interactions has gained significant importance. To accomplish this, a combination of Multi Criteria Decision Making (MCDM) and machine learning techniques has been employed. A dataset has been curated and utilized to train a model based on Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The trained model enables accurate predictions and identification of relevant information pertaining to drug interactions in biomedical literature. This approach enhances the understanding and knowledge extraction from vast amounts of unstructured text data, leading to improved insights and potential advancements in the field of biomedical research.

articleTitle: Decentralized Training for Secure Network Security: Leveraging RFB Protocol and Federated Learning in Zero Trust Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This study proposes the implementation of a Remote Frame Buffer (RFB) gateway in a zero-trust network using Federated Learning. The proposed approach allows multiple remote devices to collaboratively train a machine learning model without the need for centralized data storage, and without compromising the privacy of the data owners. The study includes an evaluation of the effectiveness of RFB with and without Federated Learning, as well as the effectiveness of local and global datasets and Gradient Stochastic Descent. The results demonstrate that the use of Federated Learning with RFB protocol is more effective than using RFB without Federated Learning for training machine learning models. The decentralized training process ensures that the data of individual devices remains protected, without the need for centralized data storage. Homomorphic Encryption and Differential Privacy techniques can be incorporated into the decentralized training process to enhance security.

articleTitle: SmartSense: An Intelligent Assistive System for Typhlotic Individuals Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents a prototype of a smart electronic assistance system designed to aid individuals with visual impairment (typhlotic persons). The proposed system comprises an ultrasonic sensor, a camera, a Raspberry Pi processor, and a headphone. The paramount intention of this research is to construct an electronic toolkit that facilitates visually impaired individuals to navigate obstacles in their path safely and independently. The system employs an ultrasonic sensor integrated into a moccasin-type shoe to detect obstructions in the user's path. When an obstruction is encountered, the sensor relays the information to the Raspberry Pi, which then triggers an audio alert through the connected headphone. Additionally, a camera is mounted on eyeglasses, providing real-time object detection and further enhancing the system's functionality. Users receive audio messages that inform them about the detected objects in their surroundings. The smart moccasin system offers a straightforward yet effective solution for assisting orientationally blind individuals and facilitating their autonomous and secure mobility, utilizing their remaining senses. The integration of ultrasonic sensing, a Raspberry Pi processor, and a camera creates a comprehensive electronic toolkit that promises to enhance the mobility and independence of visually impaired individuals, promoting a safer and more confident navigation experience.

articleTitle: A Ultra-Wideband Vivaldi Antenna with Lozenge Shaped Slots for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: As ultrawideband (UWB) systems gain increasing popularity, diverse hybrid antenna design techniques are under development and proposed for UWB applications. This research introduces an enhanced Vivaldi antenna design tailored for the frequency range encompassing 3.1 GHz to 10.6 GHz. The suggested antenna integrates lozenge-shaped slots arranged in a specific pattern, resulting in a compact antenna with dimensions measuring <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$42.8 \times 29.1 \times 1.6{\mathrm{m}}{\mathrm{m}}^3$</tex>. The incorporation of these lozenge-shaped slots enhances the antenna's gain and directivity when compared to traditional designs. The proposed design's simulation results have been achieved using HFSS, and the antenna's high gain of 5.8 dB was achieved. Although these improved performance attributes are encouraging, the antenna's suitability for biomedical applications such as brain tumor detection.

articleTitle: Performance Analysisof Brushless DC Motor DSP Control Using CCS Studio
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Brushless DC (BLDC) motors have recently been used in a variety of applications. Better power factor and efficiency can be found in BLDC motors. As a result, they generate more output power for a given frame size. These benefits of the BLDC motor come at the tradeoff of additional complexity in the control of the power converter, current shaping, and rotor position sensor requirements. This study examines various rotor position estimating methods. Encoders are utilized to sense the position of the rotor, and this information can be used to conduct the motor phases in order to achieve continuous rotation of the motor. A traditional PI controller is used to control the speed, and a hysteresis-type control technique is used to manage the current. The analog speed controller is then discretized and made digital. The DSP speed controller is programmed and simulated results are achieved using the Code Composer (CCS) Studio. The simulated results lead to the conclusion that, despite load disturbances, motor performance is good throughout a wide speed range.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Quadratic Buck Boost Converters: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In energy harvesting systems, such as solar or wind power, the available energy source may provide a relatively low voltage . Indeed, the need to efficiently capture and utilize energy from low-voltage sources has led to the development of Buck Boost converter topologies with high voltage gain. The versatility and efficiency of Buck Boost converters make them essential components in numerous applications. This paper aims to compare and analyze two advanced DC-DC power converters that have the objective of achieving a wide voltage gain The study investigates the operating principles and steady state performance of the converters using MATLAB and also a comparison of the topologies made based on voltage gain, component count, voltage stress across switches, and polarity of output voltage parameters.

articleTitle: Automatic Paddy Drying Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The process of drying rice paddies holds immense significance in rice production, profoundly influencing thequality of the final yield by ensuring the ideal moisture content. Among the conventional techniques for managing the solar drying process, manual tedding stands out –a labor -intensive procedure that entails the physical task of flipping and evenly dispersing the grains. This method remains widely practiced by Filipino farmers due to its cost - efficiency and minimal environmental impact. Nevertheless, there is an increasing demand for modernizing this process to enhance efficiency and elevate the quality of rice output. The focal point of this research is to engineer an automated tedding mechanism for sun- drying rice grains. Several forward-thinking designs were explored, encompassing a tossing mechanism, a plow-based configuration, a vacuum-assisted system, and a cutting-edge sweeper wheel concept. Following meticulous evaluation, a specific mechanism was chosen for production and subjected to rigorous testing. The findings unequivocally demonstrate the effectiveness of the chosen model in efficiently collecting and redistributing grains on the drying surface, achieving an impressively low margin of error, falling below 5%. This breakthrough holds the promise of streamlining the rice drying process, yielding time and resource savings, and ultimately elevating the overall quality of the rice harvest.

articleTitle: Harmonic Mitigation using High Pulse Rectifiers in Induction Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The three-phase induction motor is widely employed for applications requiring variable speed control due to its straightforward and robust construction. There are several methods available for speed control. The Variable Voltage and Frequency (V/F) control method is favoured to prevent flux saturation and non-linear operation of the induction motor. Initially, in the system, AC voltage is converted into DC voltage using an uncontrolled rectifier. Subsequently, the DC voltage is transformed back into AC voltage using a 3-phase inverter. The 3-phase rectifier introduces harmonics into the input current. To address this issue, multipulse rectifiers are utilized. This study involves the design of various rectifiers, including 6-pulse, 12pulse, 18-pulse, and 24-pulse rectifiers, using MATLAB to mitigate harmonics on the source side. The performance is compared based on total harmonic distortion. The performance of the induction motor drive is thoroughly investigated for different types of multi-pulse rectifiers using MATLAB, and the most suitable high-pulse rectifier is determined for applications involving induction motor drives.

Author Keywords: Variable voltage and frequency speed control method

It also be able to track the patient's blood oxygen level and exhaled lung pressure in order to prevent excess or under air by using ventilator. articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Mechanical Ventilator for Respiratory

abstract: Patients with respiratory diseases experience shortness of breath and a severe drop in blood oxygen levels. Unfortunately, improper handling can lead to death. articleTitle: Implementation of Efficient Serial Architecture for Prince Block Cipher with Enhanced Security

articleTitle: Automatic Number Plate Recognition System Using Deep Learning YOLOv5 Algorithm

articleTitle: PolyDiseaseNet: A Multimodal Machine Learning Approach for Comprehensive Disease Diagnosis and Prognosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cancer is a leading cause of death world wide, accounting for an estimated 10 million deaths in 2020 alone. Early detection and accurate diagnosis are essential for improving patient outcomes and reducing cancer- related mortality. However, traditional diagnostic methods, such as biopsies and imaging, can be invasive, time- consuming, and expensive. Deep learning, a subfield of artificial intelligence, has emerged as a promising tool for cancer prediction and diagnosis. Deep learning algorithms can be trained on large datasets of gene expression data to identify complex patterns that are associated with diverse types of cancer. Once trained, these algorithms can be used to predict the type of cancer that a patient has based on their gene expression profile. Keras, a high- level Python library for TensorFlow, provides a user-friendly framework for building and training deep learning models. Keras offers a variety of pre-built deep learning architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and recurrent neural networks (RNNs). CNNs are particularly wellsuited for image analysis tasks, while RNNs are well- suited for sequence data analysis tasks. Gene expression data is a rich source of information for identifying cancer-associated patterns. Gene expression data reflects the activity of genes within cells, and different genes are expressed at distinct levels in diverse types of cells and tissues. By analyzing gene expression patterns, deep learning algorithms can identify subtle differences between cancer cells and normal cells. This study investigated the application of deep learning using Keras for cancer prediction and diagnosis, with a primary focus on five prevalent cancer types: colon, breast, lung, kidney, and prostate. The study utilized gene expression data from a large cohort of patients to develop and evaluate deep learning models. Various deep learning architectures were explored, including CNNs and RNNs. The performance of each architecture was evaluated on a held-out test set. The bestperforming model achieved a classification accuracy of over 95% for each of the five cancer types. The findings of this study demonstrate the potential of deep learning using Keras to improve cancer prediction and diagnosis. The developed models achieved high classification accuracies, surpassing traditional methods. By analyzing gene expression data, deep learning models can identify specific genetic mutations or signaling pathways that are driving cancer growth and progression. This information can be used to select targeted therapies that are most likely to beeffective for each individual patient.

This approach involves integrating blockchain technology with IoT devices, to create a decentralized and tamper-proof system for object detection. In this system, IoT devices capture data from cameras, whichis then securely, stored in a cloud database, encrypted by a blockchain ledger. The use of blockchain technology ensures that the data is immutabletransparent andcan be accessed by authorized users only. This system leverages the decentralized nature of blockchain technology to enable secure sharing and storage of data captured by cameras used in object detection system. This abstract highlight the potential benefits of using blockchain based object detection system in border areas, including enhancing security, reliability and transparency.

articleTitle: Fully Error Compensation BLDC Motor Control Using Self Feedback Voltage Computation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The position of BLDC motor using deep neural network algorithm to implement this techniques, a sensor less control system is used, which estimate the rotor position using back of electromotive force (bemf). The bemf signals are used to determine the position of the rotor and the phase current. Brushless direct-current (BLDC) motors cannot operate efficiently without a precise commutation signal. However, commutation faults can be caused by the low-pass filter (LPF), non-ideal current, circuit, and software retarding. This can negatively impact the performance of BLDC motors, for example, by increasing current ripple and noise. A unique compensation approach is presented to rapidly reduce the commutation defects and enhance the motor performance. A counter is used to compute the compensation time. Additionally, the virtual neutral voltage provides the counter's start-stop signals. Compared to the conventional compensation approach based on the incorporation of virtual neutral voltage, the suggested method has a quicker compensation speed and greater precision and requires neither a voltage nor a current sensor.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low- cost Diabetes Level Prediction using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic disease that affects millions of people worldwide. Machine learning techniques have been used to predict diabetes with high accuracy using clinical and lifestyle data. In this study, we propose a low-cost diabetes level prediction system using machine learning. The system will use a dataset of clinical and lifestyle data to train and test machine learning algorithms, including decision tree, random forest, and neural network. The proposed system aims to achieve high accuracy in diabetes prediction while minimizing the cost of implementation. The system will be implemented as a smart web application that can be accessed by healthcare professionals and patients. The results of this study will contribute to the development of low-cost and accessible diabetes prediction systems that can improve the quality of life of patients with diabetes. (Abstract)

articleTitle: The Art of YOLOv8 Algorithm in Cancer Diagnosis using Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Cancer continues to be a global health challenge, demanding innovative solutions to improve early detection and treatment outcomes. This research project harnesses the power of deep learning in the field of medical imaging to investigate the applicability of the YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once version 8) algorithm for diagnosing various cancer types, such as Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia, Cervical, Lung, Colon, Oral, and Skin cancers. The YOLOv8 algorithm, renowned for its real-time object detection prowess, represents a promising candidate for automating the identification and classification of cancerous regions within medical images. This study encompasses a comprehensive methodology, starting with the collection and preprocessing of diverse and well-annotated medical image datasets. The YOLOv8 algorithm is then fine-tuned and trained on these datasets, capitalizing on its object detection capabilities to discern cancerous lesions. The model's performance undergoes a comprehensive evaluation using established metrics, guaranteeing its dependability and precision within a clinical setting. The findings of this study have the potential to offer insightful information on YOLOv8. By bridging the gap between cutting-edge deep learning technology and clinical practice, this research project seeks to advance the field of medical imaging and provide a foundation for more precise, efficient, and accessible cancer detection methods. Ultimately, the goal is to enhance the early diagnosis of cancer, offering new possibilities for timely intervention and improved patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Efficient Supply Chain Management System Using ARM CORTEX-M3
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A supply chain network has services and options for distribution that play out the job for materials acquirement and change from momentary to finish items and the circulation of complete items to clients. All manufacturing organizations have supply chains. This proposed supply chain management system consists of GSM module, GPS module, RFID reader and tags. This vehicle module serves for surveillance, enabling the real-time tracking, monitoring, and delivery of goods. The ARM CORTEX M3 microcontroller collects this data and offers details about the supply of goods. This supply chain management can be used by courier service, food, and automobile processing industries for real time monitoring.

articleTitle: Crop Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Food is one of life's vital resources that everyone needs in order to survive. But not everyone is entitled to a nice meal every day. The World Health Organization estimates that two-thirds of the world's population experiences food insecurity. The technologically advanced answer to this age-old problem is smart agriculture, which helps to maximize the produce of farmland with minimum resources. Crop diseases are a serious danger to food security, but it is still challenging to promptly diagnose them since the required infrastructure is lacking in many parts of the world. Since the emergence of precise techniques, impressive advancements in the field of leaf-based image categorization have been made. Training data sets are the first step in the two stages of the proposed system's operation. This involves utilizing training sets that contain both healthy and unhealthy data. Utilizing the CNN technique, which has numerous implementation steps including data set building, feature extraction, classifier training, and classification, the second stage involves crop monitoring and disease detection. CNN has been jointly trained on data sets of diseased and healthy leaves to categorise the images of damaged and healthy leaves. Overall, by using machine learning to train the big publicly available data sets, we can clearly identify the sickness existing in plants on a large scale.

articleTitle: An Investigation of a Matching Circuits for Radio Frequency Energy Harvesting Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper presents HSMS 286C diode is used as a voltage doubler (VD) circuit, different types of matching circuit has been investigated for a VD rectifier circuit with a load resistance of 3 KΩ. Matching networks for efficient RF to dc voltage conversion. For lumped, transmission line, Rogers 4350 and FR4 substrates have investigated, efficiency of the rectifier matching circuits are 80.5%, 81.2%, 62% and 32.7% respectively. For transmission line matching networks, the maximum conversion efficiency has been attained, and the overall output voltage is greater than 5 volts at an input of 20 dBm with a 3 KΩ load resistance.

articleTitle: Differentiate Music Genre from an Audio File Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The complexity of music production has gradually decreased recently, causing a big number of individuals to produce music as a result and submitting it to streaming media. Because there are so many music streaming services, people are putting in a lot of effort looking for certain songs. The result says, it's critical to be able to swiftly classify musical genres in today's culture. As deep learning and machine learning technologies progress, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) are indeed being applied in a number of disciplines, and new CNN-based versions have appeared one after the other. Manually extracting features from time-series data is required for traditional music genre classification. Applying deep learning to time-series data has proven to be useful and efficient. To save time for the user when looking for different styles of genres. Librosa is used to convert into a corresponding Mel spectrum. Converted Mel send to a CNN model for training.

articleTitle: Automated IoT Based Fog-Based Hand Wash System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: COVID-19 has spread around the world with virtually no region left untouched. The frightening death rates and rapid spread of COVID-19 have prompted numerous nations and jurisdictions to develop preventative measures, and handwashing is a key component of each and every one of them. Our hands play a crucial role in the transfer of germs. It is a simple, primary preventive measure that most people can do independently. Handwashing with soap and water for at least 20s or the use of alcoholbased hand sanitisers when soap and water are not available is the first line of defense in stopping the spread of infection. Failure to properly wash our hands results in the cross-transmission of these organisms to others. To avoid becoming sick, it's crucial to keep your hands clean, but lathering and scrubbing takes time! We want to cut water waste by 20–65% while still having everyone follow the same handwashing regimen. However, if we washing our hands under the running faucet for a whole 20 seconds, water can be wasted. The suggested method provides an alternative method that uses fog to clean hands. The suggested system's processor and fog maker module both use ATmega328 micro controllers to make water into fog. To eliminate the need for touching, the procedure uses an ultrasonic sensor to identify hands. A signal from an ultrasonic sensor must be sent to the microcontroller in order for the fog maker module to turn on when the user places their hands within the device. Handwashing instruction and information have been prioritized in response to the present COVID-19 pandemic, both for the general public and for those working in the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: A Single Phase PV combined UPQC with Novel Control Algorithm for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper explains the novel control algorithm based photo voltaic (PV) combined single-phase unified power quality conditioner (PV-UPQC) for power quality improvement. It eleminates power quality issues such as voltage sag/swell, voltage unbalance, voltage and current harmonics. Modified PLL based SRF is used for reference value generation for series ans shunt active power filters. A modified PLL -based control algorithm includes third order prefilter, low pass band stop filter (BSF). The modified algorithm applied to both filters which works effectively and completely eleminates multiple time zero crossing of incoming polluted grid voltage and exactly calculate phase detection. Adaptive Fuzzy based HCC controller is implemented for both APF gate pulse generation and PI controller is adopted for DC link voltage balancing. Fuzzy MPPT is used to extract maximum power from PV cell. The proposed system is examined by using MATLAB / Simulink. A proto type model is made to examine the simulation results. The results shows that the proposed PV combined UPQC performs good under polluted grid condition with nonlinear load system.

articleTitle: High Performance Ternary Inverter based on FinFET Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The complexity of binary logic based digital circuits is gradually increasing which demands for multi value logic. In this article an in-depth device level characteristics of SVT FinFET model is outlined. The ternary inverter designed using different FinFET models namely LVT, SVT and HVT is designed and compared which consume less power and energy than the other technology such as MOSFET and CMOS. The results show the power as 37.4, 19.3 and 15.6 (nW) for LVT, SVT and HVT models, respectively. Further, the power delay product (x 10-21J) as 88.63, 90.71 and 179.55 for LVT, SVT and HVT models, respectively. The proposed ternary inverter design is useful for computing devices, memories used in IOT and biomedical applications.

articleTitle: A Telehealth System Driven by Artificial Intelligence for Effective Patient Consultation and Diagnosis in Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Hospital patient wait times are a major problem in the current healthcare environment. Overcrowding and patient dissatisfaction can result from lengthy wait times for doctor consultations. We present a cutting-edge AI-based telemedicine solution intended for hospitals in order to solve this issue. This system enables patients to receive timely medical attention by operating via web and mobile platforms, in addition to hospital computers. The AI model underlying this system reports on and evaluates major health issues in addition to making treatment recommendations for minor disorders. This model 's effect on decreasing patient wait times and easing hospital congestion. Our technology uses artificial intelligence (AI) to improve patient experience and hospital operations by streamlining healthcare access.

articleTitle: Impact of Interruption Duration on Cost of Unserved Energy: A Survey Based Study for the Commercial Sector in Sri Lanka
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The cost of unserved energy is a parameter used to calculate the worth of electricity that is not served by a power system due to planned and unplanned outages. This figure is influenced by several factors such as affected group, duration of interruption, time of interception, etc. This paper studies the impact of interruption duration on the cost of unserved energy experienced by the consumers in the commercial sector. The study is based on a consumer survey conducted to gather the data required from the consumers belong to 15 subcategories. Using the collected data, average and weighted average cost of unserved energy due to expected and unexpected outages corresponding to 5 outage durations are computed. Results are analyzed and identified patterns in variations are discussed. The analysis reveals that the cost of unserved energy due to unexpected outages of most subcategories is high for short outage durations, when compared to that of long outage durations. Whereas, the cost of unserved energy due to expected outages gradually increases with the interruption duration. Thus, this study reveals that the cost of unserved energy shows different variations with the interruption duration for expected and unexpected outages.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Real Time Object Detection using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The study of computer systems and software that can recognize and understand scenes and images is known as computer vision. Image recognition, object detection, image synthesis, image super resolution and many other computer vision altering features. For, security systems and selfdriving cars, object detection is commonly used. In this study, we use R-CNN, RetinaNet and fast and highly accurate object recognition algorithms and methods such as SSD and YOLO. Using these deep learning methods and algorithms, also based on machine learning, requires a deep understanding of deep learning frameworks including Tensor Flow, Open CV, image, and more. By placing objects in the selected rectangular blocks, everything in the image can be recognized, named, and labeled. This includes the accuracy of each object recognition method.

articleTitle: Digital I Will Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Digital wills are legal documents that outline an individual's wishes for the distribution of their digital assets after their death. With the emergence of blockchain technology, it is now possible to create and store digital wills in a secure and decentralized manner. Decentralized blockchain technology provides a tamper-proof and immutable ledger that ensures the digital will remains secure and unchanged over time. This helps to guarantee that the individual's wishes for the distribution of their digital assets are carried out as intended, without the need for intermediaries or centralized authorities. The use of smart contracts, which are self-executing contracts that are written directly into lines of code, can help to automate the execution of digital wills. This can help to simplify the process for loved ones left behind and reduce the need for intermediaries. The use of decentralized blockchain technology for digital wills has the potential to revolutionize end-of-life planning by providing a secure and transparent method for ensuring that an individual's wishes are carried out as intended. Despite the challenges, the benefits of using blockchain technology for digital wills are significant, and this approach may become increasingly popular as blockchain technology continues to evolve.

articleTitle: D-Shaped Optical Fibre -based SPR Sensor for Environment Pollutants Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This manuscript presents a environment pollutants sensor using a D-shaped Optical Fibre (DOF). The Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) mechanism is applied for detecting the m-cresol, p-cresol, and o-cresol. In this, a DOF is decorated by a gold thin film over the flat surface to induce the SPR. The SPR phenomenon is implemented for analyzing the sensing performance in terms of resolution and sensitivity. The wavelength sensitivity is observed in terms of respective resonance wavelength (RW) shift for different cresols. The highest wavelength sensitivity of 5000 nm/RIU and a minimum resolution of 2 x 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> RIU is obtained for the sensor under consideration. Based on the promising results, this sensor can be very useful for environmental sensing applications.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation Algorithm for Web Based Hospital Appointment Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A hospital management system is an organised and computer -based system that is delineated and programmed for dealing with the effectiveness and governance of hospital management in daily life. The programme can be used to look after patient records, databases, treatments, status of illness, prescriptions, and billings in pharmacies and laboratories. They are also used to maintain patient information such as patient IDs, appointment bookings and details, and a chatbot for present-day patients. A lot of hospitals are overseeing the reports in the system, but they're not available to patients. It will provide an additional capability to pile the records in the database and make them easily accessible to the patients. An online appointment management approach allows the sick to register and book a consultation with their respective medical advisors. If the doctor calls off the set-up or arrangement, the sick person goes to the health centre. The main intention is to construct a scheme or system that can be used to an appointment with doctor can also prescribe medicines so that the patient can get them directly. Also, if there is a need for a scan or test, the patient can get the test reports from the laboratory.

articleTitle: Speed and Distance Detection for Highway Traffic using Python
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This Python -based scheme presents an innovative approach to bolstering road safety by harnessing the power of computer vision and machine learning. The primary objective is to provide drivers with crucial real-time information for informed lane change decisions, thereby reducing the risk of accidents. The system integrates advanced techniques such as object detection, tracking algorithms, and depth estimation to analyze video feeds from highway cameras. The system's core functionality involves estimating the speed and distance of vehicles on the highway. Object detection algorithms, including YOLO, SSD, and Faster R-CNN, are employed to identify and track vehicles in the video feed. Depth estimation techniques enhance accuracy by determining relative distances between vehicles. Machine learning algorithms, such as recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and long short-term memory networks (LSTMs), predict future positions and speeds, enabling the system to identify potential conflicts.

articleTitle: Vehicle Number Plate Identification and Speed Detection for Traffic Surveillance Prevention Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A traffic surveillance prevention system with vehicle number plate identification and speed detection using machine learning provides a complete traffic solution. By using only camera captures, a traffic observation system can measure major traffic boundaries from video layouts. This paper proposes to identify over-speeding vehicles' number plates and initiate an emergency message on detecting accidents. Utilizing the CCTV footage, vehicle detection takes place and the speed of the vehicle is derived using Open CV. The Number of the vehicle is recognized using contour under computer vision which is a field of machine learning that enables a computer system to derive meaningful information from digital images. The accident will be detected from the video input using the Convolutional Neural Network Algorithm and Computer Vision. On detecting an accident, an emergency message is initiated to the nearest control room with the corresponding location.

articleTitle: Estimation of Transformer Insulation Properties Under Different Nanoparticle Concentrations Using Curve Fitting Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Mineral oil based nanofluids used in transformers are recognized to have improved electrical and physical properties compared to conventionally used liquid insulation. Silica nanoparticle-based nanofluids (SNF) are also a candidate for the transformer insulating liquid. In this study, curve-fitting techniques are used to estimate the oil properties for different concentrations of nanoparticles. Firstly, samples of the SNF are synthesized using the conventional two-step procedure. The values of dielectric breakdown voltage (BDV) and interfacial tension (IFT) for different concentrations of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in SNF are obtained using experimentation. Various curve fitting models are developed considering the concentration of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> as input, and BDV and IFT as outputs. Here, curve fitting methodologies such as Exponential fit, Polynomial fit, Gaussian fit, Fourier fit, and Sum of sine fit are used. The developed model can be used to estimate BDV and IFT for any concentration of SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Detect Falls Using an Iot-Based Health Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Fall detection is a major issue in public healthcare, particularly for the elderly. When their physical condition deteriorates, prompt and dependable care is necessary to mitigate the negative impacts of cascade. The current system, designed by others, is incapable of detecting false falls and lacks a health analysis system. The proposed system monitors a person's activity, employs an effective quaternion algorithm to detect a deviation from typical diurnal conditioning, and then automatically transmits a request for assistance along with the case's location to the carers. These models were initially developed to distinguish fall from daily movements such as walking, moving, sitting, standing, reclining, and bending.

articleTitle: Pharmacy Location and Recommendation Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The medical sector has continually advanced in recent years. The integration of medical services with a centralized system, on the other hand, is effective in enhancing people's lives thanks to the technology that is currently available. This system will help people to make out their medicinal requirements in their nearby location. If the exact medicine is not available alternative medicines are recommended based on user searched medicine combination it is achieved by using the rank-based algorithm to find similar medicine. This approach will computerize all pharmacy records so that customers and pharmacists can access them whenever and wherever they choose. The proposed system is to lay out a plan of action to the consumers plus pharmacist and do the representation of web services between them. This system intensifies the engagement of unorganized pharmacies into the computerized system to lift medical assistance. In such a way, the system will become the forthcoming way of e-medicinal services and advances the approach of medicinal assistance that are given to the patients by hospitals and doctors. It also helps to get drug availability in every locality

articleTitle: Unsupervised Medical Image Denoising Using CycleGAN: Improving Low-Dose CT Image Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Medical imaging plays a significant role in clinical diagnosis, but the use of low radiation doses in CT imaging can lead to poor image resolution and precise diagnosis. In this investigation, a novel method has been suggested to enhance low-dose CT (LDCT) images using an unsupervised deep learning model based on CycleGAN. The CycleGAN architecture enables us to perform image-to-image translation without the need for paired data, making it suitable for medical image denoising where matching high-dose CT (HDCT) images are often unavailable. Our model employs two generators for LDCT-to-HDCT and HDCT-to-LDCT translation, along with two discriminators to differentiate real and generated images in both domains. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves the quality of LDCT images, yielding highfidelity HDCT-like images. This technique holds great promise for enhancing medical image quality and ultimately benefiting patient care.

articleTitle: An IoT-Based Automated Music Therapy System for Stress Management: Design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Modern lifestyles often lead to considerable mental stress, adversely impacting daily human life. These stresses cause physiological changes, such as increased heart rate and blood pressure, leading to potential health issues. Commonly recommended stress-relief strategies, like medication, can yield harmful side effects and further health disorders. To address this, we propose an innovative solution: music therapy. It has been proven to decrease stress by calming the individual and regulating brainwave activity. While some hospitals manually apply this therapy, our model automates the process using Internet of Things (IoT) technology. This model employs IoT to seamlessly deliver data to the cloud, utilizing Raspberry <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Pi}$</tex>. We measure stress parameters using a pulse sensor and an electroencephalogram (EEG). Artificial neural networks (ANN) in the cloud then compare these measured values with pre-established threshold values. When a patient's pulse rate drops below the threshold, an emergency message is automatically dispatched to the physician. Furthermore, based on the patient's heart rate, the ANN categorizes the patient's health condition and stress level. A playlist, specifically curated to the patient's mood, is then played to alleviate stress levels. By leveraging cloud storage, the individual's status can be accessed conveniently through the internet or a dedicated mobile app on the patient's smartphone. Therefore, our model offers an innovative, nonpharmaceutical solution to manage and alleviate stress in modern life.

articleTitle: Learning Automata -Based RPL Routing Protocol for IoT with Mobility (LA -RPL - Mobility)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Internet of Things, or IoT, is a technology that is transforming a number of distinct sectors. IoT networks frequently comprise a several internet enabled systems which runs on constraints, necessitating effective routing techniques to provide smooth communication. The Routing Protocol for Low-Power and Lossy Networks (RPL) has been a prominent choice for IoT routing due to its various constraints. However, the dynamic nature of IoT environments, characterized by mobile nodes, necessitates innovative solutions to acute the output of RPL. In this paper, the integration of Learning Automata (LA) into RPL routing protocol for IoT networks is done to level up the performance. The suggested integrated protocol primary goal is to optimize each packet delivery, reduce energy usage, and improve routing efficiency in mobile IoT applications.

articleTitle: ML Algorithm-Based Healthcare Predictor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: By precluding, diagnosing, and treating mortal complaint, illness, injury, and other physical and internal impairments, healthcare aims to maintain or ameliorate overall health. Health professionals(providers or interpreters) in confederated health professions generally give healthcare.
