Through an online discussion platform, our work on the Healthcare Prediction System addresses this particular issue by offering health support to the general public. The system is loaded with information about multitudinous conditions, ails, and symptoms that was gathered from dependable sources. When a stoner registers on the website, they're given the option to partake their symptoms and problems. Grounded on this information, the system evaluates the data using the applicable models and estimates the disease that the case's symptoms are most likely to be related to.

articleTitle: Bayesian Algorithm-Based Automation System for Control of Agricultural Field Parameters
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Agriculture is the most significant economic sector in our nation. Agriculture must support water conservation efforts and environmental concerns due to the rapidly rising demand for water and its supply. However, the regular operations of natural farming will be impacted by the development of wireless technologies. The sensor used in wireless networks to track soil parameters like temperature, humidity, and PH. In our proposed machine learning system, the LoRa and ESP32 Wi-fi modules are used to control the irrigation and fertiliser process. It also includes an Environment Monitoring Aggregator node, which has sensors to monitor air temperature, humidity, etc. NPK sensor used to assess the soil's chemical makeup for fertiliser management. The solenoid valve opens the specific fertiliser tank to release fertiliser into the soil based on the data gathered. Along with UV traps for pest control, this system uses current and voltage sensors to keep an eye on the motor. The obtained results of our proposed system show that the fertiliser system operates effectively and that fertiliser can be added automatically as needed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of IOT Based Real Time Traffic Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In modern world, traveling has become a very stressful task due to the unchecked population boom. People grow irritated and frustrated as a result of this, which also expensive. Numerous solutions have been proposed by researchers to address this issue. The timer model is one of the models that is currently in use. Timers may be utilized extensively to regulate traffic at each step. Another solution in use makes use to identify cars generate the necessary signals. This research presents a revolutionary image-processing -based that maintain under. Matlab 's tools, a count of vehicles from the input images is calculated, and a green signal allowing vehicles to pass is given at various times based on the count. LEDs are used to show the red and green signals in the proposed prototype, and a seven-segment display is used to show the green signal's decrementing timer.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Secure Supply Chain management using Identical Deep Multilingual Convolutional Neural Networks (IDMCNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Warehouse Management System (WMS) is a section of software that allows the user to keep track of the inventory levels and the locations in real-time. Many logistics -based companies implement WMS for implementing Order Picking Systems (OPS). Typically, the WMS offers visibility of the enterprise 's activities by managing the supply chain for warehouse management. Typically, it uses work hands to take part in many tasks based on the output. It may lead to poor performance and an increase in implementation cost, resulting in unsatisfied customers. The existence of new markets makes the warehouses hold many orders in a short period. This leads to human errors as most humans are involved in this voice picking process. Also, there are some optimization -related issues due to the manual processes. For handling this situation, the order picking operation follows various aspects for solving a broad level of planning -based issues by guaranteeing good optimization strategies. This research implements an order picking system by combining blockchain and deep learning to improve associated issues and performance. A modified architecture using a deep neural network for recognizing human activity is explained. The architecture consists of Identical Deep Multilingual Convolutional Neural Networks (IDMCNN) for achieving better tracking performance by implementing the multiple inertial measurement units. The IDMCNN offers a better solution for handling optimization -related issues. Blockchain technology ensures security with data integrity and effectively communicates to the end-users.

Author Keywords: Identical Deep Multilingual Convolutional Neural Networks

articleTitle: A Single Phase Cascaded H Bridge PV Inverter's Harmonic Compensation Strategy in an Unbalanced Condition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The cascaded H-bridge (CHB) inverter offers a significant advantage in its straightforward modular design. In a recent study, a unified multilevel inverter incorporating a unique H-bridge component was proposed. This innovative topology has been further refined to include switching devices and DC-link voltage inputs, enabling the generation of a multitude of voltage steps. This advancement is specifically aimed at enhancing control over both active and reactive power for individual DC voltage sources within a photovoltaic module, ultimately improving power quality and system reliability. The study also presents an original control strategy and proportional pulse width modulation techniques tailored for CHB multilevel inverters in grid-connected systems, where each H-bridge module can deliver variable power levels.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Artificial Intelligence Techniques for Oral Cancer Diagnosis: Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The malignant nature of oral cancer is made evident by its low average chance of survival. Oncology and surgical treatment modality advancements have only modestly improved outcomes. The rapid progression and metastasis of this type of cancer, the lack of primary symptoms, the large number of risk factors, and the general lack of public knowledge of oral malignancy are all contributing causes to its high fatality rate. Recently, it has been suggested to use artificial intelligence (AI) methods for screening for oral cancer. By using AI techniques for identifying oral carcinoma, this study collects reviewed data from possibly accessible databases and different oral cancer diagnosis techniques, evaluates them against established techniques, and gives technical information with major conclusions. We also go through some difficulties, inefficiencies, and potential future research areas for the various medical image analysis methods. A subfield of AI called ML and DL has arisen during the past ten years, and its applications in the healthcare sector have produced remarkable outcomes at lower costs and higher efficiency. For the period of 2020 to 2023, this study investigates several datasets, algorithms, modalities, and key findings used in ML and DL methodologies for the identification of oral cancer. Deep learning beats traditional machine learning for identifying oral carcinoma in large datasets, according to results from prior studies. Research gaps identified in current studies suggest that practical and scientific research is urgently required for future healthcare improvement.

Index Terms: Head And Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of DG-TFET Using Si/Ge Source n+Pocket Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: An asymmetric double-gate tunnel field effect transistor (DG-TFET) is proposed using n+pocket. Pocket incorporation boosts the electric field across tunneling junction and results in higher ON-state current and lower value of subthreshold swing (SS). Gate-drain overlap helps in suppressing ambipolar conduction and gate-source underlap improves tunneling current. The performance of different DG-TFET with Silicon/Germanium (Si/Ge) in source and pocket regions is compared. As a result, the structure with Si as source and Ge as pocket material has an ON-state current of 60.4 µA/µm. Low bandgap materials such as Ge in pocket enhance the electric field at tunneling junction and result in higher ON-state current. OFF-state current and SS are found to be 7 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−17</sup> A/µm and 29.7 mV/decade respectively. However, the ambipolar conduction still needed to be improved. Gate-drain overlap length is optimized and hetero gate dielectric is added to improve the ambipolarity of this device. The ambipolar current is suppressed by three decades and SS is reduced to 24.85 mV/decade as compared with conventional TFET.

articleTitle: Converting Structured Forms to Storable Databases using Form2DB
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Document understanding is a set of related tasks involving understanding of semantic syntactic as well as visual structure of document images. Form understanding is a subset of document understanding, which specifically deals with semantic entity relationship between elements in a form, with no prior information on form template. There are multiple models that have been developed to solve this task, however they tend to be languagespecific and rely heavily on OCR/HWR for functioning. Thus, we create a pipeline for converting form images into relational database (like SQL) data entries. We further try to implement the training process in a language-agnostic fashion. The questionanswer pairs are extracted from forms and passed to LLM, which can handle complex text-to-SQL conversion queries. We compare the performance of various modules in a qualitative manner, analysing the different errors and issues arising. We also use existing benchmarks to compare the performances of various models.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Peak-Limiting Strategies Employed in A Home Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In the past few years, energy demand has significantly increased due to modern social trends and customers, rising energy per capita worldwide. With the modernization of the electricity market, residential customers are now open to installing renewable sources and using their applications to participate in the market. The energy management and scheduling of residential loads play a key role in the most economical operation from the perspective of customers and utility. This paper presents a home energy management system to schedule nearly all types of residential appliances by employing several peak-limiting strategies and providing a comparative analysis of the total electricity cost and peak-to-average ratio. An incentive -based demand response program is also implemented and the effects of different tariffs on weekdays and weekends are also analyzed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Precoders for MIMO System for 6G Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The goal of this work is to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of a dual-functional communication and radar system. It uses a combination of novel precoder techniques to achieve both the data rate and target detection requirements of its users. A comprehensive evaluation of the performance indicators of the system for radar detection and communication is performed. The optimal power allocation techniques for the beams are then determined using the derived results. The results of the analysis are then validated through computer simulations. The developed precoders are then compared with the benchmark approaches and achieved a siginficant improvement in sum rate and energy efficiency.

articleTitle: An Optimistic Approach to Identify the Quantity of Controller to be Placed in SDN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Network administration and operations have undergone a revolution thanks to Software-Defined Networking (SDN), which offers previously unheard-of levels of efficiency, scalability, and flexibility. SDN simplifies centralized network resource management by separating the control plane from the data plane, making the network more flexible and responsive to changing needs. But as was already indicated, there are particular difficulties in implementing SDN. Determining the ideal number of controllers for the control plane of an SDN architecture is one of the major challenges in SDN. Due to their inability to efficiently manage and coordinate resources throughout the network, controllers may see a decline in network performance as a result of this constraint. Although the implementation of numerous controllers can potentially alleviate some of these difficulties by augmenting network dependability and guaranteeing uninterrupted data plane operation in the event of controller malfunctions, this strategy also entails additional complications. Operational overhead and network complexity may rise as a result of managing and coordinating several controllers. In order to tackle these obstacles, present research efforts are focused on optimizing controller-to-controller communication and coordination mechanisms, increasing the scalability of SDN systems, and developing resilient scheduling and management strategies for massive networks. Since this is regarded as the first step in addressing the issues related to SDN, we offer a method in this research to optimize the number of controllers to be integrated into the control plane within the framework of SDN architecture. Most of the time, figuring out the ideal quantity of controllers will be the first step toward more advancement.

Author Keywords: East – West interface and Traditional network

articleTitle: Data Leakage Detection Using ML
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Data Leakage is one of the major problems faced by the authorities of the corporate society. Data Leakage could be of different types such as Malicious insiders, Physical exposure, electronic communication, and Accidental leakage. The most common out of all these above -listed types is accidental leakage i.e., data leak due to human error. There have been several incidents regarding data leakage in different companies across the world. And so, our goal in this project is to achieve a solution to prevent data leakage through Machine Learning. However, the detection techs available cannot provide any absolute protection as of now. Thus, it is very essential to find a solution to this risky problem as soon as possible. This research aims to design and implement a data leakage detection system based on machine learning. Furthermore, applying the synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) is one option to overcome this imbalance problem. Known machine learning methods are regarded as one of the most effective approaches to find instances of data leaking.

articleTitle: An Improved Fusion Model from GoogLeNet and AlexNet to Predict Breast Cancer using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Despite the fact that breast cancer is one of the most common cancers to kill women due to its high mortality and ease of recurrence, an early and precise diagnosis can significantly improve the chances of a successful recovery. It is very important to diagnose the disease at beginning level to avoid any complications. Traditional early diagnosis, however, is inaccurate and depends on human experience. Since prediction accuracy and efficiency may be improved, numerous researchers have suggested several machine learning techniques. Deep convolutional neural networks like GoogLeNet and AlexNet models are chosen for the diagnosis of breast cancer because they are excellent at extracting deep characteristics from images and performing fantastic image categorization. Additionally, the GoogLeNet model and AlexNet model is integrated to form a fused model which is enhanced to make better accuracy, more specifically aimed at medically related digital images. During the diagnosis our aim is to achieve the higher level accuracy, with reduced computing weight. The enhanced model, which is more focused on breast cancer pathological sections and increases the performance, by combining the properties of two different types of network structures. The integrated proposed model achieved 97.5% Precision, 97.3% Recall, 98.3% Specificity, 98.3% Accuracy, and 98.1% F1-Score. The improved model may more precisely identify Breast cancer, reduce the likelihood of inaccurate diagnosis and delayed diagnosis due to physician personal reasons, and assist healthcare professionals in providing patient care and monitoring, making the entire evaluation and therapy process more sophisticated and effective.

articleTitle: Multi-Domain Channel Estimation in SM-OTFS for Beyond 5G Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Spatial Modulation (SM) combined with Orthogonal Time Frequency Space (OTFS) modulation has emerged as a promising communication technique for beyond 5G wireless systems. Efficient channel estimation is crucial to achieve reliable data communication in such systems. This paper implements Multi-domain channel estimation technique for Spatial Modulation-OTFS systems which operates in Delay-Doppler and angle domain for doubly dispersive channels. The work also emphasizes the importance of addressing the challenges specific to SM-OTFS, such as high-dimensional modulation and multi-path fading. The proposed system achieves thrice the spectral efficiency in comparison with the conventional SM techniques.

articleTitle: A Robust Method of Hiding Patient Secret Data Using Hybridization of Hyperchaotic System with LSB Based Encryption for Medical Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this digital native world data security and data transmission especially medical images plays vital role and the process of data transfer between ends is very crucial and authentication is must. Here the idea is to improve security of medical image using multi level watermarking technique for healthcare application. Watermarking is the important method of including meaningful information for improving security and authenticity of medical data. Thus, the proposed method gives the improved security for healthcare applications. The ISODATA classifier which classifies images into nonregion of interest (NROI) and region of interest (ROI) in a medical image. Further to enhance authenticity, the Hyperchaotic System with LSB based encryption is applying to NROI where Secret Patient Information (SPI) is inserted. Then LSB based encryption is applied to generate encrypted version. The reverse technique is applied to retrieve the medical image and patient information. The Quantitative analyses have been made to justify the effectiveness of algorithm.

articleTitle: Biometrics - Based Voting Machine Combined with Result Analysis Software
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: India is a growing nation where the electronic voting system is still in danger as a result of election cheating. Elections are a key factor in determining the country's future in the next five years. Hence the current voting system has to be more secure because the present system lacks individual identification then there is a possibility that someone may abuse another person's voting privileges. In this study, fingerprint- based voting authentication is suggested to prevent voting abuse. Here we have included software that is used to update the status of the voting count during the elections. Using Biometrics any individual can vote in any election booth near their residential areas.

articleTitle: Smart Monitoring of DC Power in E-Vehicle and Regenerative Charging Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The main purpose of this project is to monitor Parameters of electric vehicles. As people become more environmentally aware, electric vehicles are growing in popularity. They have a variety of advantages over conventional gas-powered cars, including fewer emissions and a decreased reliance on fossil fuels. Instead of implementing a prototype investigation of EV parameters. They are rapidly becoming the transportation choice of the future. Electric vehicle batteries have come a long way in the last few years. They are now much more reliable and can last for longer distances. They are becoming increasingly affordable, which is making electric vehicles more accessible to more people. This project examines the characteristics of battery management systems, their technology, and the benefits and drawbacks of using them in electric vehicle applications. This project includes the smart monitoring of power in E-vehicles, state estimation, fault analysis, data acquisition and charging the E-vehicle using solar power to improve the performance of battery in E-Vehicle. Therefore the user can check the parameters of electric car through this battery management analysis. Our project uses Matlab - Simulink as the simulation program. We built a virtual model in this software. An electric vehicle that monitors battery parameters and allows us to use the alternate battery which is using solar power as resource and this alternate battery can be automatically switched into action when the primary battery drains out. Also, our project focuses on using wireless charging technique for Electric Vehicle that is efficient and affordable.

articleTitle: Left Ventricular Ejection Fraction Estimation for Pediatric Patients using Convolutional Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Ejection Fraction (EF) estimation is a major and time consuming task in diagnosis of cardiac pathologies. This mandates the requirement of trained cardiologists with greater years of experience and is prone to subjective errors. Ejection fraction below <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$30{\mathrm{\% }}$</tex> is considered as severe Left Ventricular Dysfunction, due to weakness of heart muscles and valves. The data set consists of videos of pediatrics who undertook an echocardiographic evaluation. The proposed work is of two modules: segmentation and ejection fraction estimation. Segmentation is done on the frames to estimate the left ventricular region of the heart using U-Net architecture. Individual frames of the videos are abstracted and annotated using binary masking. Diastolic and systolic areas are found from the PSAX view and length of the left ventricular is found from the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{A}4\mathrm{C}$</tex> view. Volume of the left ventricular region is determined using systolic and diastolic volumes with the help of the Bullet Method. Various regression models have been developed and tested out to estimate the ejection fraction of the left ventricular region of the heart. The project contributes to quicker ejection fraction estimation with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$R2$</tex> score of 0.8689 which is better compared to other existing solutions.

articleTitle: Analysis of various CNN models for Placenta Cell Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Placenta plays a crucial role in fetal development and maternal-fetal communication during pregnancy. Accurate classification of placenta cells is essential for understanding various cellular processes and their implications in pregnancy related disorders. This paper offers a comparative examination of the classification of placental cells through the utilization of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs). We propose and evaluate different CNN architectures for placenta cell classification, including VGGNet, ResNet 50, DenseNet, InceptionV3. We evaluate their performance concerning accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score by employing a dataset comprising diverse placenta cell types. We also test whether creating new images using GAN gives better accuracy or not. Furthermore, we investigate the impact of rotation, translation, scaling and other data augmentation techniques, on model performance. Our study contributes to the development of automated tools for placenta cell classification, facilitating comprehensive analysis and understanding of placental function and pathology in pregnancy-related research and clinical settings.

articleTitle: Leveraging Computational Vision Techniques for Weed Detection in Crops
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The precise utilization of herbicides can result in a significant decrease in their application levels within agricultural fields. The detection system plays a vital role in smart sprayers, enabling the identification of target weeds and facilitating informed spraying decisions. The development of near-ground image capture and processing techniques for weed detection in vegetable crops is the main topic of this research. The first step in the image processing involves detecting green plants, which helps to minimize irrelevant information and streamline the weed detection process. Subsequently, the study has emphasized vegetation segmentation through the application of morphological filtering and object labeling techniques, enabling weed detection based on a threshold derived from the area of detection. The proposed methods incorporate color and area analysis techniques, effectively distinguishing between crops, weeds, and soil.

articleTitle: Neural Network-Based Handwritten Character Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Due to increased utilization of digital technologies in most day to day activities to keep and pass information, Hand- written characters recognition has become a well- liked subject of investigation because people still want to have Handwritten copies converted into electronic copies that can be kept electronically. Detection of hand- written character has got to become computer's ability to recognize and interpret accessible Hand- written input from the sources like Images, records, touchscreens. Understanding the Handwritten characters is complex because handwriting differs from person to person. The goal of this project is to create an artificial neural network-based model for handwritten character detection that can recognize certain typeface characters in part. Being a relatively young discipline, neural computing's style components are less fully defined than those of other architectures. Data parallelism was carried out via neural computers. Neural computers operate in a completely different manner than standard computers. Given a specific initial state (data input), a neural computer is prepared (not programmed) to either classify the input file into one of the many classes or to cause the original data to develop in such a manner that a specific desirable attribute is optimized. The experimental outcomes demonstrate that our suggested approach succeeds in classification accuracy on the test set of 99.3, exceeding the most recent techniques. This study offers a precise answer for real-world applications including postal automation, bank cheque processing, and signature verification while demonstrating the efficiency of utilizing neural networks for handwritten character detection. The field of computer vision and pattern recognition includes hand-written character recognition as a significant research subject. Due to its capacity to learn robust features directly from raw picture input, convolutional neural net-works (CNNs) have recently attained state-of-the-art performance in character recognition challenges.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of the Infected Rice Leaves Using RCNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The main occupation of India is agriculture. Directly or indirectly, two-thirds of the population depends on agriculture. Agriculture feeds the world. Here are some reasons affecting crop production including plant diseases, climate influences, leaf infections, pests and so on. Mainly, crop yield is heavily affected by leaf diseases. Especially on rice leaves, the disease greatly affects the yield. Deep learning with image processing techniques will be of great help in detecting diseased rice leaves at an early stage, greatly contributing to disease detection. We have proposed a method in which preprocessing using image processing techniques is performed on the images we have collected and the RCNN algorithm is used for disease detection and classification.

articleTitle: Smart Ventilators in Intensive Care: IoT-Connected Respiratory Support
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Intensive Care Units provide critically ill patients, and technology has improved patient care. This paper examines Internet of Things (IoT) integration into smart ventilators, a key ICU component. IoT-connected smart ventilators provide real-time data monitoring, remote control, and data-driven decision assistance. The study highlights IoT-enhanced smart ventilators' potential to continually gather and send patient data to healthcare practitioners, allowing fast treatments and lowering problems. These devices also enable IoT-based ventilation optimization techniques for a more personalized and effective respiratory support system. It discusses ICU IoT-connected smart ventilator adoption issues. These obstacles include data security, privacy, interoperability, and extensive regulatory frameworks. These challenges must be overcome to integrate IoT technology into respiratory support systems. It highlights the advantages of IoT-enhanced smart ventilators in critical care via case studies and practical implementations. These advantages include enhanced patient comfort, lower healthcare expenses, and minimizing healthcare personnel's stress by automating routine procedures and enabling remote monitoring and changes. As the healthcare sector adopts IoT technology, users must work together to overcome its obstacles and use its potential to improve patient outcomes and intense care.

articleTitle: Security Enhancement for the 5G Network Concerns
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Fifth era (5G) is the up and coming age of versatile interchanges with low inactivity and high information throughput. As far as these elements, 5G organizations ought to ensure incredible levels, of All clients' security and security to be safeguarded. Subsequently, scientists painstakingly assessed protection and security answers for 5G clients. 5G remote organizations offer a modern idea that tackles issues influencing past ages of correspondences. Of most noteworthy worry to numerous scientists in the cell phone industry is client protection, which is the drawn out Worldwide Versatile Endorser Identifier (IMSI) and the transient membership identifier Impermanent Portable Supporter Identifier and Cell Radio Organization Fleeting Identifier (TMSI and C-RNTI). This article investigates accessible information on client security, broadened protection, and protection settings in 5G organizations. Also, it examines a large part of the examination on client character in ID, pagination, and site refreshes. This paper talks about different security issues in 5G organizations utilizing open IMSI or impermanent identifiers (like TMSI and C-RNTI) contrasted with IMSI that spills client protection. This record likewise analyzes the accessible data on client personality and security, featuring the central matters, issues, issues and future proposals and issue arrangements.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Efficiency through Hybrid AC/DC Topologies for Rural Electrification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: A promising approach for efficiently powering both existing low-cost AC loads and DC loads is to use hybrid off-grid architectures that integrate AC and DC components. These newly developed arrangements hold considerable promise, especially in conditions like solar- and batterypowered rural electrification. A minimal amount of semiconductor components, continuous current ports for photovoltaic panels, batteries, regulation of both DC and AC load voltages, effective maximum power point tracking, security measures against battery overcharge and deep discharge, high-voltage boosting without the need for lowfrequency transformers, and a reduced power consumption are only a handful of the advantages that this approach offers. Existing approaches described in the literature are insufficiently comprehensive to include all them. A hybrid AC/DC system is introduced to fill this gap by connecting four-port converter in the front end and DC-AC converter as the next end. Mat lab simulation and experimental proto type were done to validate the results.

Author Keywords: off Grid and On Grid system

articleTitle: Smart IoT Based Water Monitoring and Control System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Water is a basic need for human life. In the coming days, the world will meet water scarcity, so it is important to limit water usage. It is an essential step to identify impurities present in the water. The proposed system provides a better solution for the existing problems. This system will terminate the flow of water when it reaches the threshold value, and if any impurities or changes in pH value are found, the flow automatically terminates. Hardware module of this proposed system consists of ESP8266, a microcontroller with integrated Wi-Fi and dual-mode Bluetooth, flow sensor, Total Dissolved Salts (TDS) sensor, Infrared (IR) Sensor, and a solenoid valve. The water flow is terminated automatically when it reaches a threshold value. Any changes in pH value or any impurities found in the water are intimated to the user and water supplier using Internet of Things (IoT) technology.

articleTitle: Automatic Concrete Surface Crack Recognition Using EfficientNetV2 Variants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Building health and structural integrity are important to ensure occupant safety and long-term durability. Monitoring and assessing building condition regularly ensures that potential problems are identified early. This research aims to develop and implement a deep-learning (DL) supported tool to examine the concrete surface images collected using digital camera. The data gathering forms the first stage and the chosen DL algorithm is used for feature extraction followed by the feature selection and then fusion is done and finally a fivefold cross verification schema is applied for a binary classification. This work considered the EfficientNetV2 (ENV2) model with variants like small, medium and large for the examination. The investigation is implemented using individual and fused deep-features and the performance of the developed tool is confirmed using the achieved accuracy. The outcome of this research confirms that the proposed tool produces a betterment of >96% accuracy with individual-features and 100% accuracy with fused-features. These results confirm that the proposed scheme provides significant result during the crack detection.

articleTitle: Simulation Model Development for Conversion of IC Engine Vehicle to Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Electrification of personnel transport vehicle is one of the methods to overcome global warming and large dependence on fossil fuels. Moreover the life of the electric vehicle is comparatively better when compared to internal combustion engine vehicle. This paper investigates the possibilities and challenges of electric conversion from an existing IC engine vehicle. Vehicle dynamics equations are used to calculate various forces acting on the vehicle and energy consumption / <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{km}$</tex> is obtained through various drive cycles. A complete Matlab/Simscape model is been developed to demonstrate how the actual vehicle is controlled similar to the drive cycle input. A hardware prototype model is retrofitted with thermal management system for provides efficient method to maintain the temperature at the optimal level.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model to Detect and Classify Bone Fracture in X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The skeletal system of the human body is very important and bones are vital to it. A support and facilitate body movement. To detect fractures in bones, doctors use X-ray images, but this manual technique is laborious and prone to mistakes. Therefore, an automated approach for diagnosing bone fractures is required. Power electronic device modeling is a frequent use of deep neural networks, or DNNs. The proposed system, provides a deep neural network model using ResNet 50 to distinguish between bones that are healthy and damaged. But when faced with little data, our deep learning model has a tendency to over fit. The data augmentation techniques is used to increase the data set in order to overcome this problem. This stratergy uses 5-fold cross- validation and our model is able to discriminate objects with 92.44% classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Fault Detection and Vehicle Safety Using Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In India, factors affecting the increase in the number of traffic accidents are related to reckless driving, drunk driving or type-based accidents. done in the car. The highway driving department makes necessary moves based on stop accidents by displaying information on LED indicators at the side of the road but drivers don't pay attention but move on when false after. Therefore, this project seeks to set up an in -car system for detecting car crashes or providing protection at an unbeatable cost. This system checks the vehicle's health conditions, such as the brakes, tire pressure. If an occupant falls, the law does not allow the carrier to put the engine back on the vehicle. If all the tests are successful, The most important talent about this when driving a car, under the law about human damage, the operator will be warned in advance, and then the speed of the car will continue to slow down or when the motor support stops

articleTitle: Pulsed Electric Field for Food Preservation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Pulsed electric fields (PEF), a non-thermal food preservation technique, employs short electrical pulses that disable bacteria while having a negligible impact on the properties of the food. PEF technology aims to deliver nutritious meals to customers. PEF technology is regarded to be superior to traditional thermal processing methods for food quality attributes because it prevents or significantly reduces negative variations to the sensory and physical features of food. Foods that are placed between two electrodes using PEF technology are treated using high voltage pulses. Most PEF research has been centred on how PEF treatments affect the microbial inactivation of milk, dairy goods, egg-related goods, juice along with and other liquid meals. Successful applications of the PEF treatment include the inactivation of microorganisms, enhancement of pressurising productivity, and extraction of juice from food-producing plants, as well as intensifying food dehydrating and drying. The creation of a kind of solid, semisolid, and liquid food preservation system based on PEF. The creation of the chamber and the accomplishment of its tomato ketchup test A 20 kHz frequency was used to test the system.

articleTitle: RL Based Queue Selection Algorithm for Input Queued Switches: A Theoretical Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In modern computer networks, packet switching is the predominant method of transmitting data between devices. As a result, efficient packet queuing and routing strategies are essential to ensure high network performance and user satisfaction. Traditionally, queue selection algorithms have been designed using static rules and heuristics that do not adapt to changes in network traffic and topology. However, the increasing complexity and dynamism of modern networks require more sophisticated approaches that can learn and adapt to changing conditions. The main purpose of this article proposes a new queue selection algorithm that utilizes <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$RL$</tex> to learn optimal policies for selecting output ports. The algorithm we need is based on Q-learning, a popular <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$RL$</tex> algorithm that learns the action value by updating the best estimate of the <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex> value for each (state, action) pair. We present a high-level algorithmic description of our approach and discuss its key components and parameters. We also describe a simulation -based evaluation of our algorithm using a realistic network model and compare its performance with several baseline methods.

articleTitle: Autonomous Wheelchair Navigation Using Monocular Slam and Rapidly-Exploring Random Trees
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper proposes an advanced wheelchair model designed to assist physically challenged individuals and the elderly who experience difficulty in walking. The proposed model automates wheelchair functions, eliminating the need for users to repeatedly control its tasks. By modeling trajectory as a virtual map, and marking locations based on user input, the proposed wheelchair can drive autonomously towards specified destinations. The following methods are incorporated to achieve this include work: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM), Rapidly Exploring Random Trees (RRT), and Differential Drive algorithms. These techniques reduce the need for user control and enable easy navigation to previously visited locations. This innovation is particularly valuable for individuals with limited mobility, especially older adults who may find it challenging to recall locations.

articleTitle: Detection of Quinoline Liquid Using Photonic Crystal Fiber Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Quinoline is a colourless liquid that has major negative effects on people. The effects of quinoline liquid include liver damage, the potential for cancer -causing chemicals to permeate, genetic problems, skin redness, respiratorytract irritation, etc. It is frequently used as a chemical addition in medications, colours, insecticides, and other products. A very sensitive Photonic Crystal Fiber (PCF) liquid sensor is created to identify this quinoline liquid. Through the use of COMSOL Multiphysics, the model has been stimulated. The software's benefits include simplicity of use, broad applicability, and stability. The outcome will be precise. The suggested PCF's performance is evaluated using the metrics of relative sensitivity<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">,</sup> confinement loss, and attenuation loss. The suggested hollow core photonic crystal fiber's (HC-PCF) relative sensitivity is 99.53%.

articleTitle: Predicting the Price of Stock Using Deep Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In today's world, it is the best opportunity for an individual to beat the inflation effects and accumulate wealth for various life goals. But the problem comes down to the risks related to the stock market investment. As is known the stock market's nature is extremely unpredictable and volatile. So, stock market price prediction is an attempt in this domain to make investment a little safer and more reliable. The purpose of this initiative is to provide more trustworthy and accurate system for predicting the price activity of stocks. N-BEATS model is composed of a succession of stacks, each of which holds a large number of blocks. The local properties of the time series are the focus of each block's partial prediction. Before forwarding the result to the next stack, the incomplete predictions from the blocks it contains are combined in the stack. By evaluating the suggested prediction efficiency method in this research with that of other approaches, it might be argued that the advised method was successful in accurately predicting the stock price to a promising extent. The N-BEATS deep learning architecture's predictive capabilities were contrasted with that of a number of well-known time series forecasting techniques, including LSTM and ARIMA. The MAPE, MAE, and RMSE are used to calculate prediction errors and the accuracy of the models. When compared to LSTM and ARIMA models, the findings show that the created N-BEATS model has potential predictive performance and in terms of accuracy, the results reveal that N-BEATS surpasses the other two models.

articleTitle: GPS Routing of Shortest Path through Kernel Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Global Positioning System (GPS) navigation relies on finding optimal routes between locations. This paper presents a new algorithm based on kernel methods to efficiently solve the GPS routing shortest path problem. The algorithm models complex relationships between locations using kernel functions to prune the search space and identify ideal paths. We prove the algorithm guarantees globally optimal routes and runs in quadratic time, outperforming traditional methods. Implementing the algorithm on real-world road networks demonstrates superior performance, finding shortest paths orders of magnitude faster compared to benchmarks like Dijkstra's algorithm. Additional optimizations further improve scalability and efficiency. Case studies showcase applications in traffic navigation, logistics, and emergency response. The kernel algorithm's novel formulation, optimality guarantees, and empirical results on large-scale GPS routing problems highlight its potential as an enabling technique for next-generation navigation systems.

articleTitle: Digital Currency Fees Payment Portal Using Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This is a blockchain based web application, used to pay student's fees in digital currency from various department in a university. In this application an admin can enter details for the students from various departments. The admin can also check the student's fees payment status along with their basic information. The admin also creates the students profile and generate their user password. In the student's fees portal, the students can view their fees receipt, see their due date for the fees payment and pay fees through crypto currencies. The students are redirected to a secure payment portal where a QR code is shown. The code can be scanned and payment can be made to the admins crypto currency wallet. The crypto currency from the student's wallet is transferred to the admins account through secure blockchain consensus mechanism. The admin stores all the data of the students and their payment status using smart contracts. These blocks cannot be modified or deleted, this system provides only add a new block with updated data, which makes the data secure and we can find when the data is modified and by whom the block has been altered.

articleTitle: Development of A Multipurpose Healthcare Mobile App Using JAVA
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Health care has become an essential part of present human life. The preliminary requirement to select the basic information about medical facilities through a mobile app will serve the needs of the common people. This paper presents an integrated mobile app developed using JAVA. This app is user-friendly in terms of login, registration, and bookings. articleTitle: Rotor Design and Modeling for Switched Reluctance Motor to Minimize Torque Ripples
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Switched reluctance motors (SRMs) have found extensive use in various applications due to their simplicity and robustness. They have been employed in low-power servomotors, high-power traction drives, and even household devices. However, one significant issue with SRMs is their tendency to generate acoustic noise and vibrations, primarily caused by torque ripple. Torque ripple, the variation in torque output during the motor's operation, is a key contributor to the acoustic noise and vibrations in SRMs. To mitigate these issues, design modifications can be made to the stator and rotor magnetic structure of the SRM. One approach to reducing torque ripple is by introducing design changes, such as using different culverts on the rotor and stator and incorporating circular holes in the rotor poles. In the case of a standard SRM design, variations like a U-shaped culvert and a modified U-shaped culvert can be created at the unaligned position of the rotor. The impact of these design alterations on torque ripple is evaluated using finite element analysis (FEM) for a specific SRM model, such as the 6/4 model. By reducing torque ripple through design modifications, SRMs can operate more quietly and with reduced vibrations, making them more suitable for a wider range of applications.

articleTitle: Classification of LGG/GBM Brain Tumor in MRI Using Deep-Learning Schemes: A Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Brain abnormalities require immediate medical attention, including diagnosis and treatment. One of the most severe brain disorders is brain tumor, and magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is frequently used for clinical level screening of these illnesses. In order to categorize brain MRI images into low-grade gliomas (LGG) and glioblastoma-multiform (GBM), a deep learning strategy will be implemented in this work. The steps in this scheme are as follows: (i) gathering data and converting 3D to 2D; (ii) deep features mining using selected scheme; (iii) binary classification using SoftMax; and (iv) comparison analysis using selected deep learning techniques to determine the best model for additional refinement. The LGG/GBM photos are thought to be gathered by the Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) database. The results of this study demonstrate that max-pooling offers a higher accuracy than average-pooling based models, and the performance of the created scheme is validated using both average- and maxpooling. In the chosen models, the result of VGG16 is superior for the LGG/GBM detection task.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Detect Phishing Webpages Hosted on Compromised Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Nowadays cybercriminals host malicious webpages on the legitimate domains to bypass existing anti-phishing methods. Therefore, this paper presents a new hyperlink-based mechanism to identify the phishing webpages hosted on a authenticate domains. The proposed approach is fast, reliable, third party independent, and able to filter the webpages written in any textual language. Moreover, the proposed approach can also identify the legitimate source of the phishing webpage. The results outcomes demonstrate that the proposed method is very accurate in the detection of phishing and legitimate webpages as it has 97.92 % of true negative rate and 97.34 % overall detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Effect of Electronic Customer Relationship Management Towards Customer Experience with Mediating Factor Service Quality in The Insurance Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Electronic customer relationship management (E-CRM) has emerged as a crucial tool for companies seeking to provide a superior customer experience in the insurance sector in India. This study aims to investigate how E-CRM affects customer experience while service quality serves as a mediator. The research methodology is purposive sampling and utilises a quantitative approach, surveying a sample of 300 insurance policyholders. The data was gathered using a meticulously designed questionnaire and subsequently put to analysis employing structural equation modelling using SMART PLS. The study's findings show that E-CRM significantly improves Service Quality and Customer Experience in the insurance industry. This finding is consistent with previous research highlighting the importance of E-CRM in enhancing customer experience in various sectors. Additionally, it has been determined that service quality serves as a partial mediator between E-CRM and customer experience. This implies that service quality is vital in transforming E-CRM resources into an enhanced customer experience. The findings also indicated several implications for insurance companies operating in India. Firstly, the study highlights the importance of investing in E-CRM technologies such as chatbots, mobile apps, and social media platforms to enhance customer experience. Secondly, the study emphasises the importance of maintaining a high level of service quality, which can be achieved by investing in staff training, improving processes, and leveraging technology.

articleTitle: Tracing the Origin of Social Media Post
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Social media sites and networks play a vital role as a medium to share images, videos, documents, etc. the rate of information and data transfer is increasing rapidly. With this, there is a severe increase in cyber-crimes like stalking, defaming, fake profile generation, spreading fake messages and images, etc. Existing systems use PRNU-based image processing for identifying the social media application from which the fake post was downloaded. However. They fail to identify the source social media account from which the image was obtained. So, to overcome such a problem this project aims to help developers and investigators develop a standard unique mechanism for social media to easily trace out the origin of the user who shared or uploaded a particular image file on the social media platform by using Secure Hash Algorithm (SHA - 1). This is accomplished through the use of metadata and the hashing of login details, which aids in the investigation of the spread of fake photos on social media platforms.

articleTitle: Dynamic Network Intrusion Detection System for Virtual Machine Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The biggest issue right now is cloud security, which is why many experts have invested a lot of time and energy into research and development over the past few years. Hackers could use a virtual machine's vulnerability to the cloud in the cloud to launch a massive DDoS attack. DDoS assaults often start with multiple steps of exploitation, infrequent vulnerability scanning, and compromise of vulnerable application virtual machines (VMs) to create botnets, followed by Distributed Denial of Service attacks using the compromised botnets. We provide the NICE system, a distributed vulnerability measuring, monitoring, and mitigation selection solution with multi-stage. To stop susceptible virtual machines from being used where VM security has been compromised. In a virtual networking context, NICE is a multi-stage fully distributed detection and mitigation architecture that detects and investigates suspicious cloud load without interfering with user applications or cloud services.

articleTitle: Smart Device for Vehicle to Evade Calamities in Smog
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Smog is a severe issue which reduces visibility for drivers and causes major accidents. To address this problem, a smart device can be installed in vehicles to help drivers navigate through smog and avoid potential accidents. This device utilizes a Node MCU, a powerful microcontroller, to gather data from various sensors. With the help of this device, collision on other vehicles can be reduced to a major extent. As a further advancement, ultrasonic sensors are used to detect the obstacles such as an animal or a rock present on the road. The benefit of this project is to eliminate the limitations of dedicated shortrange communication (DSRC) protocols, cellular- relay (CR) V2V communications and the need for cellular base stations which is required in existing system.

articleTitle: A Common Ground Bridgeless Buck Boost PFC Converter With Negative DC Output Voltage Based on Board Bi Directional Charger for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper provides a creative battery charger for electric vehicles is presented that uses common ground bidirectional on board (EVs) with positive DC output voltage, with an emphasis on the G2V (grid-to-vehicle) and V2G (vehicle-to-grid) technological systems that link cars to houses. Due to their widespread use in EVs, on-board chargers (OBCs) are becoming more necessary because of their affordability and simplicity of installation. The vehicle's compact cabin and rapid charging time will allow OBC to be very efficient and power-dense. Here, a general-purpose, dual-stage, common ground on- board charger is modelled. It performs well under a diverse variety of input and negative DC output voltage conditions. A bidirectional common ground buck boost converter makes up the first stage. It minimizes EMI common mode filtering and offers positive DC output voltage. The second stage is an isolated bidirectional filter integrated into the DC-DC converter that provides galvanic isolation and regulates battery current to ensure that batteries are charged and discharged safely.

articleTitle: HACE Theorem Based Data Extraction to Enhance Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In this research article, we present an original big data processing model that makes use of the HACE theorem in order to fully realize the big data revolution's potential and enhance agricultural growth. Additionally, our study suggests a three-tier data mining paradigm for effective on-platform massive dataset storage, processing, and analysis. The information provided by this framework is exact and pertinent to raising agricultural output. The rapid advancement of networking, data storage, and data acquisition capabilities has sped up the spread of big data, which is characterized by its multi-sourced, autonomous, complex, and rapidly expanding datasets, across many research and engineering domains, including the physical, biological, and biomedical sciencesIn this study, we provide the HACE theorem, which clarifies the characteristics of the Big Data revolution, as well as a Big Data processing model from a data mining perspective. Our strategy includes user interest modeling, demand-driven data source gathering, mining, and analysis, as well as security and privacy considerations. We look into the difficulties brought on by the Big Data revolution and the data-driven approach. We apply the k-means and Naive Bayes algorithms to large data clustering and classification, and we use Hadoop's Map Reduce method for big data mining. Big Data, the HACE theorem, Map Reduce in Hadoop, and data mining are key concepts in this context. The adapted proposed model underwent training, validation, and testing where it achieved 98.3% Accuracy.

articleTitle: Precautions for Maritime Boundary Limit Using Geo Tracking and Wave Buoy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: International maritime boundary violations have become a significant concern between countries. To address this issue, this work presents a system that combines geolocation tracking and wave buoy technology to help ensure compliance with maritime boundary limits by establishing an artificial buffer zone (BZ) following the International Maritime Boundary Limit (IMBL) and divided into two segments. Boats will only be allowed to cross the border after they have crossed the BZ. The system uses a GPS module to track the boat's location and a wave buoy to measure the wave height, which are critical factors for the safety of the fishermen. A microcontroller processes the data and triggers an alert if the boat is approaching the boundary limit or if the wave height exceeds a safe level. These precautions will help ensure that maritime boundary limits are accurately established and maintained, reducing the risk of accidents and improving the safety of maritime traffic.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Prediction Using Linear Regression Techniques

articleTitle: Comparing the Performance Measures of Underwater Image Enhancement Through Improved CNN With Gaussian and Kalman Filter Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Underwater imaging poses several challenges due to the complex interactions of light with the water medium, resulting in poor image quality characterized by color distortion, blurring, and low contrast. This project focuses on optimizing underwater image quality using an improved convolutional neural network (CNN) method combined with the gausian filter technique and the performance measures are compared with Kalman filter technique. The proposed method consists of two main stages. First, an enhanced CNN architecture is designed to effectively learn and extract informative features from underwater images. The architecture employs advanced techniques such as residual connections, batch normalization, skip connections, identification of region, colour correction, future extraction to improve the network's performance in capturing the intricate details of underwater scenes. Through extensive training on a large dataset of underwater images, the CNN model is trained to understand the complex characteristics of underwater distortion and enhance the images accordingly. In the second stage, gausian filter and Kalman filtersare applied separately to the CNN-enhanced images to improve the PSNR, MSE, Sensitivity, Time Correction, Specification, colour accuracy and contrast. This step effectively mitigates color cast and enhances the overall visual quality of the images.

articleTitle: Distributed Lens-Based Beamforming for Robust Millimeter Wave 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The Millimeter wave (mmWave) 5G network challenges through distributed lens-based beamforming using programmable metasurface lenses. Unlike conventional phased arrays, these lenses manipulate wavefronts to achieve desired radiation patterns, eliminating the need for extensive digital processing and synchronization. The paper presents analytical models, optimization methods, and a prototype meta-surface lens at 28 GHz for basic validation. The approach offers distributed operation, adaptability, and efficiency benefits, marking a significant step in next-gen wireless systems.

articleTitle: Modified Zeta Converter for Electric Vehicle Battery Charger with Improved THD
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In recent times, there has been a noticeable increase in the demand for integrating electric vehicles into the existing power grid. The seamless incorporation of electric vehicles into the conventional grid infrastructure has become achievable through advancements in diverse power semiconductor bias arrangements and the evolution of power electronic transformers. These technological developments have paved the way for an effective interface that enables electric vehicles to operate optimally at their maximum power output. Among the various solutions available for integrating renewable energy and electric vehicles, the Modified Zeta Converter (MZC) stands out as a widely embraced topology. This specific configuration of the Modified Zeta DC -DC converter serves multiple purposes, including offering galvanic insulation through a high -frequency motor and facilitating bidirectional power transfer while minimizing the impact of harmonic distortions. The control strategy of the Modified Zeta Converter is based on a phase shift modulation approach, where power is shifted from leading ground components to lagging ground components. To validate the efficacy of this design, comprehensive simulations and practical experiments have been conducted with the converter, yielding valuable simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Accurate Chest Disease Classification: A CNN-Based Approach for Lung Cancer Subtypes and Normal Cells

abstract: This exploration paper presents a profound learning approach for the grouping of chest sicknesses, zeroing in on cellular breakdown in the lungs subtypes (Adenocarcinoma, Enormous cell carcinoma, Squamous cell carcinoma) and typical cells. articleTitle: Enhancing Keyword Spotting in Noisy Environments: A Deep Learning Approach with MFCC and Bidirectional LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Keyword spotting (KWS) plays a pivotal role in voice -assisted technologies, enabling prompt system activation upon detecting specific keywords in a user's speech. However, robust KWS in noisy environments remains a challenge. This research work presents a novel deep learning -based approach for keyword spotting, leveraging mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) and Bidirectional Long Short -Term Memory (BiLSTM) networks. The proposed system extracts MFCC features from audio samples and employs a BiLSTM network to capture long-term dependencies in time sequences, analyzing both forward and backward contexts. The network is trained on the Google Speech Commands Dataset, and data augmentation techniques are utilized to enhance its performance in noisy conditions. The effectiveness of the trained model is evaluated, demonstrating its ability to accurately spot keywords amidst background noise. The research work offers valuable insights into improving voice-assist technologies and contributes to advancing keyword spotting techniques in challenging real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Enhancing ECG Analysis through Deep Learning-Based Waveform Segmentation: A Time-Frequency Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This research work focuses on the automation of electrocardiogram (ECG) waveform annotation and segmentation utilizing deep learning techniques. The ECG signal, which represents the electrical activity of the human heart, consists of distinctive components such as the P wave, QRS complex, and T wave. Manually annotating these regions is a time - consuming task, necessitating the exploration of automated approaches. To address this challenge, a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network is employed and trained on a dataset sourced from the publicly available QT Database. This research contributes to streamlining the analysis of ECG data, enabling rapid assessment of heart health and the identification of abnormalities.

articleTitle: Advancing Media Integrity through AI-Powered Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In today's fast-paced information era, combating fake news proliferation is crucial. This study proposes an innovative Fake News Detector system, utilizing machine learning to analyze news articles. The system collects, preprocesses, extracts features, and classifies articles as genuine or fake. It employs Natural Language Processing to detect linguistic patterns of misinformation and learns from extensive training data. Rigorous testing assesses its performance, emphasizing accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score metrics. In an age of information overload, the Fake News Detector empowers individuals to distinguish credible information from misleading content, contributing to the fight against fake news and promoting a more discerning society.

articleTitle: LIDAR & Thermal Camera Based Braking and Life Saving System With Actuator Shield for Wheels
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: Heavy vehicles for public transportation and goods carriers are playing a vital role in the national economy. Heavy motor vehicles, such as buses and trucks, have an inadvertently higher ground clearance, which is a disadvantage during road accidents when people fall and get trapped under the vehicle's wheels. To save people's lives, in this paper an actuator shield based life-saving system is proposed and developed. The system consists of LiDAR ranging system, a thermal camera, and a Raspberry Pi-based fast computing system interfaced to control a dynamic servo-actuated angular shield for wheels. The LiDAR range-sensing sensor detects the road surface to vary the ground clearance of the wheel's shield, which maintained the ground clearance of some height to avoid hitting obstacles. To find the human falling near the wheels, the thermal camera plays a vital role. When the human is detected, it actuates the servo motors and shield to zero ground clearance, and thus people are saved by keeping them from getting under the wheels. The entire system consumes less power and is simple to install, so it can be retrofitted to existing vehicles, resulting in no deaths from vehicle collisions. As a result, the proposed system is used to save lives from the heavy vehicle accidents at low initial cost and low maintenance cost.

articleTitle: Investigating the Fake News Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: The extensive volume of data available on online platforms, such as social media, poses challenges in our ability to recognize, evaluate, and rectify misleading information, commonly referred to as “fake news.” Ensuring the accuracy of information disseminated on the internet, particularly on social media, has gained increasing significance. In this document, we present a technique for detecting false information and explore potential applications across various social media platforms, including Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and news websites. To create a supervised machine learning model capable of categorizing news articles as either accurate or false, we review prior research on fake news detection and investigate established machine learning algorithms, including Naive Bayes, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, and Stochastic Gradient Descent. We propose utilizing Python's scikitlearn library to execute text preprocessing tasks like tokenization and feature extraction. This library provides valuable tools such as the Count Vectorizer and TF-IDF Vectorizer, which facilitate feature extraction and text data vectorization. Subsequently, based on the outcomes of the confusion matrix, we may apply feature selection methods to enhance model performance and identify the most influential features for achieving high precision. Our findings demonstrate that machine learning approaches can effectively tackle the issue of discerning false news.

articleTitle: Real-Time Fire Detection in Unmanned Ground Vehicles Integrating YoloV5 and AWS IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: This paper aimed at the development of a remotely controllable 4-wheeled unmanned ground vehicle (UGV) capable of transmitting realtime sensor data and live video feeds over the internet. The central innovation lies in the utilization of an advanced object detection model, to detect fires within the live video feed. By leveraging a Raspberry Pi 4 with 2GB RAM, AWS IoT Core, MQTT, HTTP, and TCP protocols, the UGV achieves seamless data exchange. AWS IoT Core serves as both MQTT broker and subscriber, with the UGV as publisher for sensor readings and subscriber for control commands. The web app acts as the publisher for control commands, generating signals based on user input. The Remote. it software plays a pivotal role in facilitating a cloud-based HTTP service for live video streaming, thereby significantly enhancing global accessibility. Moreover, diverse remote operation methods including keyboard, onscreen, and speech controls, provide flexible means for user interaction. The integration of YOLOv5, Tensorflow, and OpenCV yields a robust fire detection capability, effectively triggering SMTPbased email alerts. This system effectively showcases the seamless fusion of robotics, IoT, web technologies and machine learning, thereby contributing to safety enhancement and inspiring a wave of future advancements.

articleTitle: Expressive and Deployable MIMO Using Chaos Shift Keying System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In communication high-dimensional data can be exchanged wirelessly between diverse system. The primary goal of this research is differential chaos shift keying modulation. The system aims to achieve a good balance between simplicity, fast data throughput, and energy efficiency. In this MC-DCSK design a sequence of chaotic reference is supplied to each user over a predetermined subcarrier frequency. Each user's leftover subcarriers are used to broadcast a number of modulated data streams. The transmitter structure of this traditional DCSK system design can be enhanced through energy and spectrum efficiency. An entirely new Karatsuba trick is explained and demonstrated to operate both theoretically and practically using the Karatsuba Algorithm (KA)'s Knuth multiplication, Karatsuba multiplication and their temporal complexity. The experiment shows that Karatsuba multiplication is more efficient for large integer multiplication than the original Karatsuba multiplication method. We investigate the energy consumption of control and data packet communications between two sensor nodes, each having cooperating nodes, in this study. We compare our cooperative protocol's energy consumption, i.e., aggregation and error data collection, to the channel cost protocol and the disjoint-paths scheme.

Author Keywords: Multi user Multi Carrier Differential Chaos Shift Keying (MC-DCSK)

articleTitle: Development Of Low-Cost Posture Detection System for Healthy Sitting
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In today's fast-paced and demanding work culture, proper posture is essential for good health and well-being. This is particularly true for India's growing IT sector, where employees spend long hours sitting at desks. This paper presents an innovative and low-cost IoT solution that uses pressure distribution statistics gathered from three FSR sensors positioned on the chair's sitting and back sections to monitor body posture. The collected data is transmitted through a NodeMCU and stored in a Firebase database, which identifies the standard sitting posture of the shoulder blades and lower thighs. If the system detects incorrect posture, the FSR sensor immediately alerts the user via a Flutter app on their smartphone. This not only helps employees maintain a healthy posture, but also benefits the elderly and mobility-disabled individuals.

articleTitle: Raw Bayer Pattern Image Synthesis on Histogram of Gradients for Pedestrian Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on System, Computation, Automation and Networking (ICSCAN)
abstract: In recent days, there has been a vast implementation and emergency for many pedestrian detection methods. In the current scenario, the complexity of pedestrian detection has increased, and its identification is a challenging task due to the variety of scenes and the complexity of most pedestrian identification systems. The availability of challenging public datasets has fueled most of the progress made in recent years. To keep up with the rapid pace of innovation, the proposed work is a pedestrian detection approach based on the Bayer pattern and gamma correction that efficiently classifies pedestrians and non-pedestrians.
